title: Sr. Executive - HR
description:
**. Biometric Attendance Management**

* Monitor and manage daily employee attendance through the **biometric attendance system**.
* Ensure all employees are properly mapped to the respective biometric devices/locations.
* Monitor daily **Present, Absent, Late Coming, Early Going, LOP, and Missing Punches**.
* Coordinate with Branch HR/Managers for regularization of attendance discrepancies.
* Ensure timely correction of missing punches and attendance\-related issues.
* Generate and review monthly attendance reports before payroll processing.
* Monitor employee transfers, new joinings, resignations, and biometric device mapping.

**2\. Payroll Inputs \& Salary Processing**

* Collect, verify, consolidate, and submit **monthly payroll inputs** within the defined timeline.
* Prepare salary inputs covering:
* Attendance and LOP
* New Joinings
* Resignations/Exits
* Salary revisions
* Promotions and increments
* Transfers
* Incentives and variable pay
* Leave adjustments
* Recoveries and deductions
* Arrears and other salary adjustments
* Cross\-check payroll inputs with HR records and approved documents.
* Coordinate with Payroll/Accounts for timely and accurate salary processing.
* Verify payroll reports and identify discrepancies before salary finalization.

**3\. Leave \& Attendance Coordination**

* Monitor employee leave records and ensure proper updating in the HRMS.
* Coordinate with employees and reporting managers regarding leave and attendance discrepancies.
* Ensure leave applications and attendance corrections are processed within the prescribed timelines.
* Monitor LOP and ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before payroll closure.

**4\. HRMS / VHRMS Management**

* Maintain accurate employee master data in the HRMS/VHRMS.
* Update employee joining, transfer, promotion, salary revision, and exit details.
* Ensure attendance, leave, and payroll\-related information is accurately reflected in the system.
* Generate MIS reports as required by management.

**5\. Monthly Payroll Reconciliation**

* Reconcile attendance data with payroll inputs before salary processing.
* Compare current\-month payroll with previous\-month payroll to identify unusual variations.
* Verify employee\-wise salary changes, deductions, incentives, LOP, and arrears.
* Coordinate with concerned departments for correction of discrepancies.
* Maintain proper records of approved payroll inputs for audit and future reference.

**6\. Statutory Payroll Inputs**

* Coordinate with the concerned HR/Payroll team for accurate inputs relating to:
* PF
* ESI
* Professional Tax
* TDS
* Bonus and other applicable statutory deductions
* Ensure employee master data required for statutory compliance is updated and accurate.

**7\. MIS \& Reporting**

* Prepare and submit regular reports on:
* Attendance
* Absenteeism
* Late Coming
* LOP
* Headcount
* New Joinings
* Exits
* Payroll inputs
* Salary revisions
* Incentives
* Provide accurate payroll and attendance MIS to Management/HR Head within the stipulated timelines.

**8\. Employee \& Branch HR Support**

* Act as a point of contact for employees and Branch HR teams regarding attendance and payroll\-related queries.
* Resolve routine salary, attendance, leave, and biometric\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers and HR representatives to ensure timely submission of required inputs.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee salary and personal information.

Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Full Time

Managing Director

* Company Secretary

* Recruitment Agencies

* Labour Law Consultants
* Legal Advisors

**About the Role**

The role includes recruitment, organizational development, HR operations, employee engagement, statutory compliance, performance management, compensation, succession planning, learning \& development, and HR analytics.

**Talent Acquisition**

**Organization Development**

* Design organizational structures.
* Define reporting relationships.
* Develop competency frameworks.
* Create career progression paths.

* Drive change management projects.

**Performance Management**

* Implement annual performance appraisal systems.
* Coordinate goal setting and reviews.
* Facilitate performance calibration.
* Support performance improvement plans.
* Align individual goals with business objectives.

**Learning \& Development**

* Prepare annual training calendars.
* Coordinate technical, behavioural, and leadership training.
* Evaluate training effectiveness.
* Develop leadership development programs.
* Promote continuous learning culture.

**HR Operations**

* Manage employee lifecycle processes.
* Oversee attendance and leave administration.
* Coordinate payroll inputs with Finance.
* Maintain employee records.
* Manage HRMS.
* Ensure timely employee documentation.

**Employee Relations \& Culture**

* Promote employee engagement.
* Handle grievances professionally.
* Conduct employee satisfaction surveys.
* Support conflict resolution.
* Organize employee communication and recognition initiatives.
* Foster a positive, high\-performance workplace culture.

**HR Policies \& Compliance**

* Develop and update HR policies.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws and employment regulations.
* Coordinate statutory compliance relating to employees (PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, etc.) with Finance and consultants.
* Maintain HR compliance records.
* Support internal and external compliance audits.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Support salary benchmarking.
* Manage annual increment and promotion processes.
* Coordinate incentive and bonus programs.
* Monitor employee benefits.
* Assist in workforce budgeting.

**HR Analytics \& Reporting**

* Prepare monthly HR dashboards.
* Track recruitment metrics.
* Monitor attrition, absenteeism, and productivity.
* Report workforce statistics to management.
* Provide data\-driven recommendations.

**Leadership Support**

* Advise management on HR strategy.
* Support departmental workforce planning.
* Assist in talent reviews.
* Facilitate leadership meetings related to people management.
* Contribute to strategic business planning from an HR perspective.

**Key Deliverables**

The selected candidate will be responsible for ensuring:

* Timely hiring against approved manpower plans.
* Structured onboarding and induction.
* Clearly defined organization structure.
* Up\-to\-date job descriptions for all positions.
* Effective KPI/KRA\-based performance management.
* Annual training and development plans.
* Strong employee engagement.
* HR policy framework aligned with business needs.

* Reliable HR dashboards and workforce analytics.

**Required Skills**

* Talent Acquisition
* Organizational Development
* Performance Management
* Learning \& Development
* HR Strategy
* Employee Engagement
* Labour Law Compliance
* Compensation \& Benefits
* Succession Planning
* Change Management
* HR Analytics
* HR Operations
* Conflict Resolution
* Leadership Development
* Workforce Planning
* HR Policy Development
* HRMS Administration
* Interviewing \& Assessment

**Software Knowledge**

Must Have

* Microsoft Excel

* Microsoft PowerPoint

Preferred

* Recruitment Portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed)
* Payroll Systems
* Power BI
* ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems)

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for an HR professional who:

* Has built or transformed HR systems in a growing organization.
* Can partner with leadership to build a high\-performance culture.
* Has strong recruitment and organizational development capabilities.
* Understands labour law compliance and HR governance.
* Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, coaching, and communication skills.

* Completion of annual performance appraisal cycle.

* Training hours per employee and training effectiveness.
* HR compliance adherence.

**Why Join?**

* Opportunity to build the HR function of a growing NSE SME Listed company.

* Leadership role with end\-to\-end ownership of people and organizational development.

title: Welfare Officer
description:
**Job Purpose:**


We are looking for a dynamic and people\-oriented People Experience Partner to support the HR function at our manufacturing plant in Arakkonam.


The role will be responsible for day\-to\-day HR operations, employee welfare, employee engagement, HR documentation, benefits administration and employee lifecycle activities at the plant. The role will also support the Plant HR Head in Industrial Relations, statutory compliance, contract labour management and workforce\-related activities.


The position will serve as an important interface between employees, contract workmen, supervisors and the HR team, ensuring timely resolution of employee queries and delivery of a positive employee experience at the plant

**Key Responsibilities:**

**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations for plant employees and support end\-to\-end employee lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate with Payroll and relevant stakeholders on attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee\-related queries.
* Support preparation of regular HR MIS and plant HR reports.

**Employee Welfare \& Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for employee welfare\-related matters and provide timely support to employees.
* Understand employee concerns and grievances and escalate matters appropriately to the Plant HR Head.
* Coordinate employee welfare activities, celebrations, recognition initiatives and other plant\-level employee engagement programmes.
* Maintain a positive and employee\-friendly work environment while ensuring alignment with business requirements.
* Support awareness programmes relating to employee welfare, safety and wellbeing.

**Employee Relations \& Industrial Relations Support**

* Maintain regular interaction with employees and shop\-floor teams to understand workplace concerns.
* Support disciplinary and employee\-relations processes, documentation and follow\-up as directed by the Plant HR Head.

**Statutory Compliance \& Regulatory Coordination**

* Support the Plant HR Head in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws, employment regulations and factory\-related requirements.
* Maintain required HR, employee welfare and statutory records and registers.
* Support preparation of documents and information required for statutory inspections, audits and reviews.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and external agencies for compliance\-related activities.
* Assist in ensuring timely renewal, documentation and maintenance of relevant licences, registrations and records.
* Support liaison and coordination with statutory authorities and external agencies whenever required.

**Contract Labour Management**

* Support the Plant HR Head in the administration and monitoring of contract labour.
* Coordinate with contractors regarding attendance, manpower deployment and employee documentation.
* Support monitoring of statutory compliance by contractors, including PF, ESI, wages, bonus and other applicable requirements.

**Recruitment \& Workforce Support**

* Support hiring of shopfloor, blue\-collar and other plant positions based on manpower requirements.
* Coordinate with recruitment consultants, local sourcing channels, ITIs, skill centres and other sources as required.
* Assist in screening, interview coordination, selection documentation and joining formalities.
* Coordinate pre\-employment documentation and Background Verification (BGV) processes for Pan India locations.

**Background Verification \& Employee Documentation**

* Liaise with BGV agencies and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of verification.
* Track pending cases, follow up on exceptions and maintain appropriate records.
* Ensure employee documentation is complete, accurate and appropriately maintained.

**Employee Benefits \& Insurance Administration**

* Support Corporate People Experience team in administration of Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Life Insurance and other applicable employee benefit programmes.
* Coordinate employee enrolment, additions, deletions and corrections under applicable benefit schemes.
* Support employees with insurance claims and coordinate with brokers, TPAs and service providers for resolution of queries and escalations.
* Support annual renewal and related employee communication activities.

**HR MIS, Employee Communication \& Audit Support**

* Prepare and maintain regular HR MIS relating to headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment, employee movements, welfare activities and other plant HR metrics.
* Conduct or coordinate employee communication sessions and awareness programmes.
* Support internal and external HR audits and provide required documentation.
* Maintain appropriate records of vendor activities, audits and corrective actions.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Undertake any other HR, employee welfare or plant\-related responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager.
* The incumbent will be the designated Welfare Officer for the Arakkonam plant and will discharge the responsibilities of the Welfare Officer as applicable to the plant.

**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**

* 4\-7 years of experience in HR, preferably in a manufacturing, industrial or plant environment.
* Freshers with relevant academic qualifications and strong interest in Plant HR / Employee Relations may also be considered.
* Exposure to labour laws, Industrial Relations or employee welfare will be an advantage.
* Strong interest in working closely with shop\-floor employees and the plant workforce.
* Strong interpersonal, follow\-up and coordination skills.

**Company Description** **Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**  

  

Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage \- the combination of our next\-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease \- no matter where they are in the world.


What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!

**Who we are:**


Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high\-stakes, high\-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.


Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel \& B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries \& territories and more than 140 currencies.


With over 1,400\+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.

 **Job Description** **The Opportunity**


Flywire is seeking a highly skilled Senior People Analytics Specialist (Workday) to strengthen the People team's ability to make timely trusted data\-informed decisions. This role will own the design, development, maintenance and continuous improvement of People reporting and analytics within Workday.


You will partner closely with People leaders, People Operations, People Technology, Finance and Business Intelligence teams to translate business questions into scalable reporting solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong Workday reporting professional who is equally comfortable working with stakeholders, improving data quality and turning complex workforce data into clear actionable insights.

**What you will do**

* Design, build, test and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, scorecards and data extracts that support People, Finance, executive and board\-level reporting needs.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear reporting requirements, including metrics definitions, data sources, security considerations, delivery cadence and expected business outcomes.
* Develop advanced Workday reporting solutions using Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, composite reports, matrix reports and related Workday capabilities.
* Partner with People Technology and Workday implementation stakeholders to support a successful post\-go\-live reporting model, including prioritisation and delivery of critical People reports.
* Establish trusted consistent definitions for core workforce metrics such as headcount, attrition, hiring, internal mobility, diversity, organisational structure and talent outcomes.
* Validate report logic and data accuracy, investigate discrepancies and resolve issues through disciplined testing and root\-cause analysis.
* Build and maintain documentation covering reports, metrics, data sources, business logic and operating procedures.
* Partner with Business Intelligence and data teams when advanced analytics, cross\-functional data sets, automation or enterprise\-level insights are required beyond native Workday reporting.
* Identify opportunities to simplify manual reporting, improve self\-service access to data and strengthen the overall People analytics experience.
* Support reporting governance by ensuring appropriate data security, confidentiality, access controls and adherence to applicable privacy requirements.
* Provide guidance and enablement to People team stakeholders on how to interpret and use reports effectively.

  

**Qualifications** **Here's what we're looking for**

* 5\+ years of experience in People Analytics, HRIS, Workforce Analytics or a related analytical role.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday, including advanced and matrix reports, calculated fields and composite reporting.
* Experience with Workday Dashboards and Discovery Boards, along with Worksheets.
* Strong knowledge of Workday HCM data structures, business processes, security domains and reporting best practice.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation and data analysis.
* Experience transforming ambiguous business questions into practical scalable reporting solutions.
* Strong analytical judgement and attention to detail, with the ability to validate data accuracy before communicating findings.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and insights clearly to nontechnical audiences.
* Experience partnering with Finance, People Operations, HR Technology and/or Business Intelligence teams.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving global environment.

**Preferred qualifications**

**Company:** Woodside Energy Ltd
  
About Woodside
  
  

We are a global energy company, providing reliable and affordable energy to help people lead better lives. Join our team at Woodside Global Solutions in Bengaluru where talent and operational excellence converge to solve complex energy challenges, accelerate change, and reimagine business capabilities to support Woodside's global operations and our role in the energy transition.
  
  

Founded in 1954, Woodside established the liquefied natural gas (LNG) industry in Australia 40 years ago and supplies customers around the globe. Seventy years on, Woodside continues to be driven by a spirit of innovation and determination.
  
  

At Woodside, we know great results come from our people feeling valued, getting the support they need to reach their full potential and working in a psychologically and physically safe work environment. We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
  
  

Refer to our corporate website for more information about our different locations and projects: What We Do
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are seeking a proactive and organised Recruitment Sourcer \& Coordinator to join our Talent Acquisition team in our Bengaluru office. In this role, you will support a streamlined and seamless recruitment experience by assisting with sourcing, coordinating recruitment activities, managing candidate communications and ensuring recruitment systems and processes are kept up to date.
  
  

You will play an important role in supporting Woodside’s employment brand and future\-employee engagement, while working closely with Talent Acquisition colleagues, hiring managers, candidates and internal stakeholders to deliver an efficient and positive recruitment process.
  
  

Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

Respond to candidate enquiries and provide timely updates throughout the recruitment process, escalating queries where required.
  
Support campaign planning, including communications, scheduling, stakeholder lists and candidate correspondence.
  
Assist with sourcing activities by setting up job brief meetings, posting advertisements to job boards and supporting internal expressions of interest.
  
Maintain accurate recruitment data, requisitions and candidate records in SuccessFactors and relevant recruitment trackers.
  
Coordinate interviews, including calendar management, room bookings, materials, interview guides and candidate communications.
  
Support assessment centre logistics, including travel, accommodation schedules and campaign coordination where required.
  
Coordinate due diligence activities, including medicals, psychometric assessments, background checks and candidate follow\-up.
  
Support offer and onboarding processes, including offer approvals, paperwork tracking, onboarding administration and system progression.
  
Provide recruitment reporting, team metrics and general administrative support across Talent Acquisition activities.
  
Assist with purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoicing, materials ordering and induction day planning as required.
  
  

Skills and Experience
  
  

Two to five years’ experience in recruitment, sourcing, talent acquisition or a related HR coordination role.
  
Tertiary qualification in Human Resources or a related discipline.
  
Experience using applicant tracking systems and recruitment tools, ideally including SuccessFactors.
  
Strong sourcing capability, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Boolean search and online talent research.
  
Ability to build and maintain targeted talent pipelines aligned to business hiring priorities.
  
Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and candidate care skills.
  
Strong attention to detail, data management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
  
Experience supporting recruitment campaigns, assessment centres, interview coordination, due diligence and onboarding activities.
  
Sound understanding of privacy, compliance and accurate document handling requirements within a recruitment environment.
  
  

Recognition and Reward
  
  

**What you can expect from us:**  

Commitment to your ongoing development, including on the job opportunities and formal programs
  
Inclusive parental leave entitlements for both parents
  
Values led culture
  
Flexible work options
  
Generous annual leave, sick leave and casual leave
  
Cultural and religious leave with flexible public holiday opportunities
  
A competitive remuneration package featuring performance\-based incentives with uncapped Employer Provident Fund
  
  

Woodside is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture, which is supported by our Values.
  
  

Inclusion centres on all employees creating a climate of trust and belonging, where people feel comfortable to bring their whole self to work. We also offer supportive pathways for all employees to grow and develop leadership skills.
  
  

If you are ready to take your career to the next level and be part of a global organisation that values innovation and excellence, apply now through our careers portal or connect with our recruitment team.
  
  

Applications close at 11:59pm IST on 30th September 2026
  
  

Click APPLY to submit your application
  
  

Please note Woodside Energy will only accept direct candidate applications. We do not accept applications from Recruitment Agencies.

title: maintanance engineer
description:
A Maintenance Engineer for Data logger/ RTU/ PLC and SCADA systems ensures the maximum uptime, reliability, and continuous operation of industrial automation infrastructure. Their core responsibilities include preventive maintenance, troubleshooting hardware and network failures, updating software logic, and performing emergency breakdowns to minimize production or utility downtime.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **Routine Maintenance:** Execute scheduled preventive and predictive maintenance on Data Logger, RTU, PLC panels, SCADA workstations, HMI screens, and industrial networks.

· **Fault Diagnostics:** Troubleshoot system faults, I/O module failures, communication drops, and loop errors under high\-pressure breakdown conditions.

· **Logic Modification:** Perform minor programming changes, logic updates, and backup management for PLC programs and SCADA graphic configurations.

· **Calibration \& Instrumentation:** Verify and maintain field instruments (sensors, transmitters, VFDs, actuators) interfacing with the control system.

· **Network Maintenance:** Monitor and maintain industrial communication links, including Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and Ethernet/IP networks.

· **Documentation:** Maintain detailed logs of breakdowns, history cards, calibration reports, change management tracking, and inventory of critical spares.

**Essential Qualifications**

· **Education:** Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or Automation Engineering.

· **Experience:** Fresher / 1 year of hands\-on maintenance experience in Electronics/ PLC \& SCDA

· **PLC/SCADA Expertise:** Working knowledge of major platforms such as Schneider Electric, or Siemens

· **Location/Mobility:** Mumbai Maharashtra

· **Soft Skills:** Strong analytical thinking, swift problem\-solving during plant emergencies, and willingness to work in rotational shifts.

**Locations:** Talegaon Dabhade  
**Department:** Human Resources Department  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary :** We are seeking an experienced and strategically minded **Senior HR Manager** to oversee human resources and industrial relations across our infrastructure projects and corporate offices. In this role, you will be responsible for the entire employee lifecycle—from high\-level talent acquisition to managing site labor compliance and industrial relations. You will act as a strategic partner to the executive team, ensuring our workforce is scaled efficiently, compliant with all labor laws, and aligned with project timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Talent Acquisition:** Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for senior project managers, billing engineers, contracts teams, and specialized technical staff. Develop robust talent pipelines to minimize project downtime.

* **Industrial Relations (IR):** Manage trade union interactions, mitigate industrial disputes, and maintain peaceful, productive employee relations at project sites.
* **Payroll \& Compensation Management:** Oversee the structural layout of employee compensation, project site allowances, and monthly payroll validation for both corporate and field\-level workforces.
* **Performance \& Talent Management:** Design and implement annual performance management systems, KPI tracking, and retention strategies for technical and managerial teams.
* **Site HR Administration:** Oversee site HR teams responsible for worker accommodation (camp management), transit safety, health insurance protocols, and on\-site basic amenities.
* **HR Budgeting \& Reporting:** Prepare, monitor, and manage the annual HR department budget. Deliver data\-driven HR analytics and reports to corporate leadership.

**Requirements and Qualifications**

* **Education:** **MBA in Human Resources, Master’s in Human Resource Management (MHRM), or a Master’s degree in Labor Laws / Industrial Relations**.
* **Experience:** **5\+ years of progressive HR experience**, with at least **3 years explicitly within the infrastructure, real estate, EPC, or heavy construction sectors**.
* **Core Competencies:** Advanced knowledge of labor law compliances, proven experience in resolving site\-level worker disputes, and stellar negotiation skills.
* **Software Skills:** Proficiency with enterprise **HRMS software** (e.g., Darwinbox, SuccessFactors, Zoho) and advanced MS Excel for workforce data analysis.
* **Key Attributes:** High emotional intelligence, strong leadership presence, and the resilience to travel to active project sites as needed.

title: Enterprise Solutions & Deal Enablement Associate
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


TartanHQ builds **HyperSync** (a unified API layer connecting HRMS, ERP, and CRM systems) and **HyperVerify** (a unified verification platform for KYC, KYB, income, employment, and contact\-point checks, used by banks, NBFCs, insurers, and lenders).  

We're hiring three **Enterprise Solutions \& Deal Enablement Associates** to sit directly with the solutioning lead, founders and CBO, and become the connective tissue between our enterprise clients and every internal team that has to say "yes" before a deal goes live \- Product, Engineering, InfoSec, Legal, and Finance.  

This is not a pure sales role and not a pure support role. You will:* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.
* Own the internal chase: security questionnaires, MSAs/DPAs, commercial paperwork, technical scoping so deals don't stall waiting on an internal team
* Stay the client's single point of contact through the entire journey, from first solutioning conversation through contracting to go\-live, so they never feel dropped between teams
* Bring an end\-to\-end ownership mindset: if something is blocking a deal or a client, it's your job to notice, chase, and resolve it, not to wait for someone to ask


You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
------------------------------

* **Deal Cycle Turnaround:** Reduce time from first solutioning call to signed contract through proactive internal coordination
* **InfoSec/Vendor Questionnaire Turnaround:** Coordinated response within 3\-7 business days of receipt
* **Contract\-to\-Go\-Live Time:** \< 30 days for standard integrations, tracked jointly with Product/Engineering
* **Client Response Time:** \< 4 hours during business hours for any active deal or account query
* **Internal SLA Adherence:** 90%\+ of InfoSec/Legal/Finance/Product touchpoints closed within agreed internal timelines
* **Active Relationships Managed:** Ability to concurrently manage 8–12 live deals/accounts without dropped threads
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Positive feedback from both external clients and internal teams (Product, InfoSec, Legal, Finance) on responsiveness and clarity

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Deal Support \& Solutioning (35%)**

* Support the leaders through discovery calls, solution walkthroughs, and RFP/RFI responses for enterprise prospects
* Translate client requirements (HRMS/ERP/CRM integration needs, or KYC/KYB/income/employment verification needs) into a clear internal brief for Product/Engineering
* Prepare first\-cut proposals, solution decks, sample payloads, and commercial summaries to keep deal momentum going
* Track every open opportunity in a shared pipeline/tracker and flag stalled deals before they go cold

### **2\. Cross\-Functional Coordination – InfoSec, Legal, Finance, Product (30%)**

* Own the InfoSec review process for prospects (security questionnaires, ISO 27001/ISO 27701/AICPA/DPDP compliance documentation, VAPT reports) in coordination with the infosec teams, chase, don't wait
* Coordinate MSA, DPA, SOW, and NDA drafting and redlines between the client and TartanHQ's legal counsel, keeping a clear track
* Work with Finance on commercial proposals, pricing confirmations, PO tracking, and invoicing setup for new accounts
* Liaise with Product/Engineering to confirm technical feasibility, connector availability, and realistic go\-live timelines before commitments are made to clients

### **3\. Client Relationship \& Communication (25%)**

* Act as the client's primary point of contact through the deal cycle and into early production, so the relationship survives handoffs between internal teams
* Run a regular communication cadence (calls, status emails, WhatsApp where appropriate) with enterprise stakeholders including BFSI, NBFC, travel, insurance and pension\-sector clients
* Represent client context accurately back to the leaders and internal teams, no information getting lost in translation
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, additional endpoints) during ongoing conversations and flag them to the leaders

### **4\. Documentation, Reporting \& Process (10%)**

* Maintain a single source of truth for every deal's status: commercial, legal, security, and technical via CRM
* Provide the leaders with a clear weekly view of what's moving, what's stuck, and what needs their direct involvement

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------

* 1–3 years in a client\-facing, coordination\-heavy, or B2B support role (sales support, business operations, account management, pre\-sales, or similar) \- strong freshers with excellent communication will be considered
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Hindi fluency a plus for BFSI/enterprise stakeholder conversations)
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, comfortable chasing multiple internal teams without being told to
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable running trackers/spreadsheets across many parallel deals
* Professional, composed, and articulate when dealing with senior enterprise stakeholders
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Basic working understanding of APIs/integrations sufficient to coordinate (not required to write code)
* Proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel; comfort learning CRM/tracker tools quickly

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech, BFSI, or API\-first companies (internships count)
* Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes: security reviews, legal redlines, vendor onboarding
* Exposure to the lending, insurance, travel, or pension ecosystem
* Familiarity with HRIS, accounting / expense tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Greythr, Zoho, Tally, SAP, etc.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Notion, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* **Client\-first mindset:** Genuinely cares whether the client had a good experience, not just whether the task got closed
* **Ownership mentality:** Drives things to completion with minimal supervision; treats "not my job" as not an option
* **Professional \& sincere:** Represents TartanHQ credibly in front of senior stakeholders at large enterprises
* **Coordination discipline:** Can hold 8\-10 moving threads at once without dropping any of them
* **Composure under pressure:** Enterprise deal cycles involve last\-minute asks and shifting timelines, stays steady through it
* **Growth mindset:** This function is being built from scratch; you'll help shape the playbook, not just follow one

title: Resident Staff Nurse
description:
We are actively hiring **dedicated and qualified Staff Nurse** to join our school as a campus resident at The Peepal Grove School, Gongivaripalli, Sadum mandal.

**Positions Available**:

* **Resident Staff Nurse**

**Minimum Requirements**:

* Certified nursing degree (GNM/B.Sc. Nursing, A.N.M).
* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.
* Compassionate, team\-oriented, and committed to patient care.
* Single/ready to stay in single accommodation on campus.

**Duties \& Responsibilities1\. Healthcare \& Medical Duties**

* Provide **first aid and emergency care** to students and staff whenever on campus.
* Administer **medications and treatments** as per prescriptions and standing medical orders.
* Conduct **regular health check\-ups** and monitor students with **chronic illnesses** (asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, etc.).
* Maintain a **clean, well\-stocked infirmary** with necessary medicines and first\-aid supplies.
* Maintain all medical equipment in working order and ensure its hygiene for use.
* Track **immunisations and vaccinations**, ensuring compliance with health regulations.
* Implement **quarantine protocols** during outbreaks of contagious diseases.
* Offer **counselling and health guidance** for minor ailments, injuries, and preventive care.
* Coordinate with **doctors, hospitals, and specialists** for referrals and emergency cases.
* Maintain **confidential medical records** for all students and report health concerns to the **Principal and/or Bursar**.

**2\. Emergency \& Safety Preparedness**

* Be **on\-call for first aid and emergencies** whenever on campus.
* Develop and implement **medical emergency protocols** for injuries, illnesses, and other incidents.
* Train **students and staff in first aid, CPR, and basic health protocols**.
* Ensure **first\-aid kits are stocked** across key school areas (dormitories, classrooms, sports grounds, etc.).
* Conduct **health and safety drills** in coordination with school administration.

**3\. Procedural \& Administrative Responsibilities**

* Maintain a **daily log of infirmary visits** and submit **weekly/monthly reports** to the Bursar.
* Monitor and **replenish medical inventory**, ensuring timely procurement. Track expiry dates of medicines in stock and discard periodically while maintaining the stock of essential medicines and vaccines.
* Liaise with **kitchen staff to accommodate dietary restrictions** for students with medical needs.
* Ensure proper **sanitation and hygiene** in the infirmary and coordinate with housekeeping if required.
* Submit timely monthly reports (by the 1st of every month) on doctor’s visits for timely remuneration to the visiting doctor.
* Reviewing health records and medical requirements of boarding students at the time of returning to school and while departing to home. Confidentiality of medical records is to be maintained.
* Attend **staff meetings** and contribute to discussions on student well\-being.
* Ensure compliance with **health and safety regulations** applicable to residential schools.

**4\. Mental Health \& Wellness Support**

* Identify and address **stress, anxiety, or mental health concerns** in students.
* Work closely with the principal, **teachers and house parents** to monitor students’ emotional well\-being by providing inputs proactively.
* Actively promote **healthy lifestyle habits** through awareness sessions on hygiene and nutrition through assemblies and hostel visits.

**5\. Campus Engagement**

* **Dine in the school’s dining hall**, ensuring familiarity with students’ health\-related dietary needs.
* Provide medical cover in **sports meets, evening sports activities, and other school events**, whenever it does not interfere with core medical duties.
* Provide **medical supervision during outdoor activities, field trips, and school treks**.
* Be a **visible and approachable figure** in the school community to encourage students to seek medical help when needed.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Pileru, Andhra Pradesh: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have any experience in child care?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

License/Certification:

* Nursing License (Required)

Work Location: In person

Savemom is looking for a **Full Stack Designer** to support the design and development of intuitive, engaging, and visually appealing digital products. This role combines UI/UX design, visual design, motion, prototyping, and basic front\-end development.

This role is ideal for candidates with a background in **Design, UI/UX, Visual Communication, Computer Science, or related fields**. Freshers with strong design skills, creative thinking, and a good portfolio are encouraged to apply.

**Key Duties**

* Create clean, intuitive, and visually engaging interfaces for web and mobile products
* Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interactive design concepts
* Work on typography, layouts, colors, icons, illustrations, and other visual assets
* Contribute to design systems and reusable UI components
* Create UI animations, micro\-interactions, transitions, and motion elements
* Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs
* Work closely with product, design, and development teams throughout the product lifecycle
* Support the development of user\-friendly and responsive digital experiences

**Experience**

* 0–2 years in UI/UX design, visual design, product design, or a related field

* Experience working on web or mobile product design is a plus

* Familiarity with **Figma**
* Good understanding of UI/UX design principles
* Understanding of typography, color, layout, spacing, and visual hierarchy
* Good understanding of user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and responsive design
* Good eye for detail and visual consistency
* Knowledge of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**
* Basic understanding of front\-end development and how designs are translated into functional interfaces
* Knowledge of Lottie, Rive, or After Effects is a plus
* Interest in UI animation, micro\-interactions, and motion design
* Strong creative, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Interest in startups, healthcare technology, and digital product development
* Willingness to learn and experiment in a fast\-paced startup environment

**Portfolio**

* A portfolio, personal project, college project, or any work demonstrating **UI/UX, visual design, or motion design** is preferred

title: Sales Analyst
description:
SALES ANALYSTJob Summary

We are looking for a **Sales Analyst** to support the sales team by analyzing sales data, identifying business trends, preparing reports, and providing actionable insights to improve sales performance. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, good knowledge of Excel, and the ability to work with large volumes of data.

Key Responsibilities

* Collect, analyze, and interpret daily, weekly, and monthly sales data.
* Prepare sales performance reports and management dashboards.
* Track sales targets, achievements, growth, and performance by region, product, and salesperson.
* Analyze sales trends and identify opportunities for business growth.
* Monitor product\-wise, territory\-wise, and customer\-wise sales performance.
* Prepare sales forecasts based on historical data and current market trends.
* Identify gaps between sales targets and actual performance.
* Support the sales team with data\-driven insights and recommendations.
* Maintain and update sales databases and MIS reports.
* Monitor distributor/customer sales and identify slow\-moving or high\-performing products.
* Prepare management presentations and business review reports.
* Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Production, and other departments for accurate data.
* Ensure data accuracy and resolve discrepancies in sales reports.
* Develop and improve Excel\-based reports, dashboards, and automated MIS.
* Provide ad\-hoc analysis and reports as required by management.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel** – Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, IF, charts, and dashboards.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of **Power BI** is an added advantage.
* Basic knowledge of sales and business KPIs.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to handle large datasets.
* Good time management and coordination skills.

Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field**.
* **2\-3 years** of experience in Sales Analytics, MIS, Business Analytics, or a related role.
* Freshers with strong Excel and analytical skills can also be considered.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Sales report accuracy and timely submission.
* Sales target vs. achievement analysis.
* Forecasting accuracy.
* Quality and usefulness of sales insights.
* Dashboard and MIS reporting efficiency.
* Data accuracy and database maintenance.
* Timely support to the sales team and management.

**Preferred Candidate:** A candidate who is **analytical, detail\-oriented, business\-focused, and comfortable working with Excel and sales data**.

Pay: From ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Palantir Foundry Data Engineer
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

 As a member of the Compliance Operations team, the Data Foundry Engineer develops and supports user\-facing data applications and data solutions built on Palantir Foundry. This role partners with business stakeholders and technical teams to digitize and automate Compliance processes by building reliable data pipelines, scalable data models, intuitive applications, and AI\-enabled solutions where appropriate.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Develop, enhance, and support user\-facing applications using Palantir Foundry Workshop and custom widgets.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable, user\-friendly data applications.
* Develop and maintain frontend application logic using Foundry Workshop and React, where applicable.
* Monitor and improve application performance, usability, reliability, and functionality.
* Build and maintain API\-driven data ingestion pipelines.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using Python and SQL within Palantir Foundry.
* Transform and structure data for downstream applications, analytics, and reporting.
* Support the design, development, and maintenance of the Palantir Foundry Ontology.
* Develop reusable datasets, data models, and data assets to support application development and reporting.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and refine technical and functional requirements.
* Deliver solutions across the data lifecycle, from external data ingestion and transformation through application deployment.
* Troubleshoot issues across data ingestion, transformation, ontology, and application layers.
* Participate in application testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement activities.
* Apply established standards for data quality, validation, monitoring, operational support, and reusable data engineering practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, application performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Support AI\-enabled solutions and integrations where appropriate within Compliance workflows.


**What You Will Bring**
* 2\- or 4\-year college degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 2–5 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a related technical field.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines.
* Experience developing data applications, dashboards, or other user\-facing analytical tools.
* Experience working across data ingestion, transformation, modeling, and application development workflows.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.


**What Will Set You Apart**
* Experience with Palantir Foundry, including Code Repositories, Transforms, Ontology, and Workshop.
* Experience developing applications using Palantir Foundry Workshop.
* Experience building custom widgets or other user\-facing applications within Foundry.
* Familiarity with frontend development technologies such as React.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, dbt, or similar modern data platforms and engineering technologies.
* Experience designing or maintaining ontology\-based data models.
* Experience building API\-based data integrations.
* Experience developing or supporting AI\-enabled data applications or workflows.
* Experience working in financial services, Compliance, or another regulated industry.

title: Assistant, People Operations
description:
***World Change Starts with Educated Children®***
=================================================

**IMPORTANT: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.**
=============================================================================================================================================================

**Position Overview:**
----------------------


Primary responsibilities are tactical in nature, involving the implementation and administration of HRIS/Workday, POSH processes, Performance Management Support, Employee Orientation and Induction, Employee Engagement support and Learning \& Development support. This position reports to the Sr. Manager, People Operations. The following duties are exemplary of the type of tasks that may be assigned at the discretion of the Director, People Operations.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

### **Workday HRIS End\-to\-End Management:**

* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle transactions in the HRIS, including creation of employee IDs and onboarding of new joiners.
* Create and manage Supervisory Organizations and ensure accurate organizational structures in the system.
* Process and update employee transfers, reporting changes, terminations, and other employee movements.
* Process Leaves of Absence, including maternity, paternity, and other applicable leaves.
* Conduct monthly HRIS audits to identify discrepancies, ensure data accuracy, and maintain up\-to\-date employee records.
* Ensure timely and accurate HRIS updates in line with organizational policies and processes.

### **POSH Process Management:**

* Manage and coordinate the end\-to\-end POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) process across the organization in accordance with the POSH Act and organizational policies.
* Coordinate with the Internal Committee (IC) and relevant stakeholders for POSH\-related processes, including complaint management, documentation, meetings, and proceedings.
* Support the planning and coordination of POSH awareness sessions, IC orientations, and employee sensitization programs.
* Maintain confidential POSH records, documentation, and reports while ensuring timely and appropriate follow\-up on cases and related processes.
* Support periodic compliance activities and ensure adherence to statutory and organizational POSH requirements.

### **Employee Orientation \& Induction Management:**

* Plan, coordinate, and conduct employee orientations and induction programs for new joiners across the organization.
* Coordinate with relevant departments and stakeholders to ensure timely completion of functional, organizational, and policy\-related orientations.
* Schedule and facilitate virtual and in\-person induction sessions and track completion of mandatory onboarding activities.
* Gather feedback and continuously improve the orientation and induction process based on employee and stakeholder inputs.

### **Annual Performance Management \& Promotion Support:**

* Support and coordinate the end\-to\-end annual performance appraisal process across the organization.
* Coordinate with managers, employees, and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of goal setting, performance reviews, evaluations, and final ratings.
* Maintain and update performance\-related records and HRIS data throughout the appraisal cycle.
* Support the communication and implementation of appraisal outcomes, including salary revisions, promotions, and related HR actions.
* Monitor timelines, follow up on pending activities, and ensure the appraisal process is completed accurately and within defined timelines.

Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include a thirteenth month bonus, health insurance and a retirement plan. **Room to Read is a child\-safe organization.**
-----------------------------------------------

**Read is a child\-safe organization; all personnel must adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy.**
============================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Room to Read is an equal opportunity employer committed to identifying and developing the skills and leadership of people from diverse backgrounds.**
=======================================================================================================================================================

  

**Child Protection Principles**
===============================

* Room to Read is committed to the education and welfare of children and protecting them from abuse and exploitation
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for child abuse and exploitation.
* All children have the right to be free from abuse and exploitation, including neglect, maltreatment, and physical, mental or sexual violence, injury or abuse.
* All children should be treated with respect and dignity.
* The well\-being of the child is Room to Read’s first priority when dealing with all identified or suspected cases of child abuse.
* Room to Read shall integrate child protection into all its organizational strategies, structures and work practices.

**Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Principles**
===================================================================

* Room to Read Representatives must create and maintain an environment that prevents sexual exploitation and sexual abuse.
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for adult sexual exploitation and abuse.
* Sexual exploitation and abuse are serious violations of fundamental human rights and will not be accepted or tolerated.
* All adults should be treated with respect and dignity.
* Room to Read implements a survivor\-centered approach, putting the survivor’s rights and dignity at the forefront.
* Survivors referred to available professional assistance (e.g. mental health counselling), upon consent.

 ***About Room to Read:***

  



Founded in 2000 on the belief that World Change Starts with Educated Children®, *Room to Read envisions a world free from illiteracy and gender inequality, where all children have room to read, learn and grow – creating lasting change*. Through our Literacy Portfolio, we train and coach teachers of the early grades in literacy instruction; create and publish quality books and curricular materials in local languages; and establish children’s libraries filled with diverse children’s books that can be enjoyed at school and home. Our Gender Equality Portfolio supports adolescents, particularly girls, in developing life skills that promote gender equality, helping them to pursue lifelong learning and make informed decisions.


We support young people of all genders to overcome gender biases and build the knowledge and skills to create a gender\-equal world. Room to Read collaborates with local communities, partner organizations, publishers, and governments to test and implement innovative models that can be integrated into the education system to deliver positive outcomes for children at scale. To date, Room to Read has benefited more than 50 million children in 28 countries.


Learn more at www.roomtoread.org.

title: Senior Manager - ServiceNow Development
description:
Overview:

ServiceNow Developer is a senior hands\-on technical role responsible for leading complex platform development, guiding developers, reviewing code, enforcing standards and ensuring high\-quality delivery across ITSM, HRSD and ESM. The role combines deep development expertise with leadership accountability for technical execution.

  

This role works closely with Technical Leads, Product Managers, Architects and Scrum teams to translate product priorities into technically sound and maintainable ServiceNow capabilities. The Lead Developer also mentors junior developers and supports global/offshore delivery teams through clear guidance, reusable patterns and high\-quality technical documentation.


Responsibilities:
**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**ServiceNow Development \& Configuration**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop ServiceNow configurations, customizations and enhancements based on approved user stories and technical designs.
* Build and maintain Service Catalog items, Record Producers, catalog variables, workflows, Flow Designer flows and approvals.
* Create and maintain Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, notifications and scheduled jobs.
* Configure forms, lists, dashboards, reports, knowledge articles and employee\-facing portal experiences.
* Maintain development documentation, configuration notes and deployment records.

**ITSM Delivery**
-----------------

* Develop enhancements for Incident, Problem, Change Enablement, Request Management, Service Catalog, Knowledge and CMDB processes.
* Support workflow automation, SLA configuration, assignment logic, notifications, templates and reporting requirements.
* Assist with ITSM process improvement by translating functional requirements into platform configuration and scripts.

**HRSD Delivery**
-----------------

* Configure and enhance HR Case Management, Employee Center, Lifecycle Events, Employee Journeys and HR Knowledge capabilities.
* Support confidential HR workflows through proper role, group, data and access\-control configuration.
* Improve employee self\-service through catalog design, knowledge surfacing, case deflection and digital experience improvements.

**ESM Delivery**
----------------

* Build enterprise service workflows for Workplace Services, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Legal and Corporate Functions.
* Develop request intake, approvals, routing, case handling, fulfillment workflows and reporting for non\-IT service teams.
* Support expansion of ServiceNow as a shared enterprise workflow platform.

**Testing, Deployment \& Support**
----------------------------------

* Perform unit testing, peer testing and support system, integration and user acceptance testing.
* Prepare update sets or deployment packages in alignment with release management practices.
* Support production troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect remediation and go\-live hyper\-care.
* Contribute to upgrades, patching, regression testing and platform health activities.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
=========================================

* Candidate should have 9\-11 Years of total experience
* 4–6\+ years of ServiceNow development and administration experience.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM and exposure to HRSD and/or ESM workflows.
* Strong JavaScript knowledge and experience with ServiceNow scripting patterns.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience developing integrations using REST, SOAP or Integration Hub.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**
====================

* ServiceNow: Service Catalog, Flow Designer, ITSM, HRSD, Employee Center, Knowledge, Reports, Dashboards and CMDB fundamentals.
* Scripting: JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, ACLs and UI Policies.
* Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, Angular, AJAX, JSON, XML and web services.
* Integration: REST, SOAP, Integration Hub, OAuth concepts and API troubleshooting.
* Delivery Tools: Azure DevOps or similar backlog tools, release tracking, test documentation and deployment checklists.

**Certifications**
==================

* Required: ServiceNow CSA; ServiceNow CAD preferred for hands\-on development roles.
* Preferred: CIS\-ITSM, CIS\-HRSD and ITIL v4 Foundation.

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

The Associate Consultant will provide guidance to resource managers and vendors on program processes and contribute to data\-driven improvements in the contingent workforce program.  



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* **Operational Management:**


	+ Oversee and manage all day\-to\-day operations of the contingent workforce program within the designated location(s) / group(s).
	+ Act as the primary point of contact for contingent workforce program\-related issues.
	+ Ensure compliance with local labor laws, regulations, and company policies related to contingent workers.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Achievement:**


	+ Develop and implement strategies to improve performance and address any identified gaps.
	+ Maintain high quality standards in all aspects of the contingent workforce program.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in a timely and effective manner.
* **Program Initiatives \& Improvement:**


	+ Identify areas for improvement within the contingent workforce program and propose solutions to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance.
	+ Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for contingent workforce management.
* **Stakeholder Management:**


	+ Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including resource managers, HR business partners, and procurement teams.
	+ Provide guidance to resource managers on contingent workforce program processes and requirements.
	+ Collaborate with resource managers to understand their talent needs and ensure appropriate use of contingent workers.
* **Vendor Management:**


	+ Partner with vendors to facilitate sourcing of contingent staffing needs.
	+ Collaborate with vendors to ensure a thorough understanding of staffing requirements, enabling effective sourcing of qualified contingent workers and timely, efficient fulfillment.
	+ Verify vendor adherence to program policies
	+ Maintain vendor POC lists
* **Reporting \& Analysis:**


	+ Monitor program performance, including KPIs, SLAs, and cost savings.
	+ Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
	+ Present findings and recommendations to program leadership.
	+ Identify and report on cost savings opportunities within the contingent workforce program.
* **Compliance:**


	+ Ensure compliance with all applicable labor laws and regulations related to contingent workers in India.
	+ Ensure compliance with program requirements.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:**
* At least 3 years of experience in contingent workforce management, HR operations, or a related field.
* **Skills:**


	+ Strong understanding of contingent workforce management principles and best practices.
	+ Knowledge of local labor laws and regulations related to contingent workers in India.
	+ Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
	+ Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	+ Experience with Vendor Management Systems (VMS), specifically Workday VNDLY.
	+ Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	+ Strong organizational and time management skills.
* **Key Competencies:**


	+ Results\-Oriented: Demonstrates a strong focus on achieving results and meeting deadlines.
	+ Problem\-Solving: Identifies and resolves problems effectively and efficiently.
	+ Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively with all stakeholders.
	+ Teamwork: Works collaboratively with others to achieve common goals.
	+ Adaptability: Adapts to changing priorities and requirements.
	+ Continuous Improvement: Seeks opportunities to improve processes and performance.

Job Summary
  
  

* Group Internal Audit and Investigations (GIAI) is looking for an accomplished and highly motivated audit professional with a robust background and strong expertise around the key risks and controls in the Human Resources (HR); Corporate Affairs Brand and Marketing (CABM) and Strategy portfolio which fall within the wider Functions and Group Chief Operating Officer (GCOO) portfolios..
* The role\-holder will be an integral part of the Functions and GCOO Audit teams. The team provides independent assessments of risk management and internal control environment of HR, CABM and Strategy globally.
* We pride ourselves in being auditors of the future, forward\-looking and agile with a keen focus on smarter auditing. When you join us, you will enter a role that challenges the status quo and moves mindsets and be a part of the future of banking


Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Support Audit Directors and Senior Audit Managers where required, in the development of the GIA risk assessment and development of an appropriate audit plan for the HR, CABM and Strategy portfolio;
* Propose audits for coverage during the audit cycle based on their knowledge of the business;
* Audits assigned to the individual in the audit plan should address the key risks identified in the detailed risk assessment and in the audit planning process and meet relevant regulatory requirements and expectations that are required to be covered by GIAI.
* Ensure that audit team operates in line with the Audit Charter during engagements, remains independent from management and free from interference.
* Build the knowledge, awareness and confidence across the GIAI teams so that over time, support for HR, CABM and Strategy audits outside of the GCOO and Functions team can be tailored to need and that functional and product teams are confident in completing relevant audit tests.


Business
  
* Effectively manage the cost of assigned audits within the allocated budget for their areas within audit engagements


Processes
  
* To act as Team Lead/ Team Member on assigned audit work across the Group.
* Provide technical input and challenge on audit work being undertaken within the scope of assigned product area of responsibility. This will include working with the audit team to produce outputs of high quality which address the areas of greatest risk.
* When Team Leading to provide clear guidance, detailed review and supervision of the audit team’s work so that audit deliverables meet quality standards and timelines in line with the GIA methodology.
* When Team Leading to provide guidance on business/audit technical knowledge and management skills to team members to enable them to effectively deliver their assigned contributions for an audit.
* Support adherence to the GIA methodology in all areas of the audit engagement, as well as raising awareness and understanding of the methodology.
* Demonstrate sound knowledge of both business/technical areas and expert knowledge in the audit process, including the GIAI system, so that audit work is carried out to a high standard that meets all methodology and GIAI system requirements.
* Monitor the implementation/delivery of the agreed issues/audit plans for the audits assigned, understanding the key risks arising, provide advice on resolution of issues to auditees/action plan owners and escalate audit findings that remain unresolved.
* Demonstrates strong foundational analytics skills, with the ability to independently design, execute and interpret data driven audit tests. description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Position Summary**


Provides governance, delivery management, financial oversight, and portfolio reporting support across the Market Change \& Modernization (MCM) portfolio. Serves as a key partner to Program Managers, Portfolio Leadership, Finance, and Governance stakeholders to ensure projects and programs comply with organizational governance standards. Coordinates portfolio\-level reporting, forecasting, audit readiness activities, health checks, risk management, gating processes, and executive governance materials while facilitating delivery transparency and operational effectiveness across multiple strategic initiatives.

Leads governance and delivery management activities across multiple programs and projects within the MCM portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and controls.


Owns and facilitates portfolio reporting processes including Clarity status reporting, executive governance reporting, health checks, project metrics, and delivery transparency initiatives.


Coordinates monthly and bi\-weekly forecasting, financial reporting, budget tracking, variance analysis, and project financial governance activities.


Develops and maintains governance artifacts including PWG/PSG materials, project health checks, RAID reporting, decision logs, dependency tracking, and audit evidence repositories.


Facilitates cross\-functional governance forums, stakeholder reviews, working groups, and status review sessions with program leadership, delivery teams, and senior management.


Acts as a subject matter expert for Clarity PPM processes, governance reporting, forecasting, status reporting, project setup, portfolio hygiene, and reporting best practices.


Supports audit remediation efforts by coordinating evidence collection, documentation reviews, process adherence, and governance control activities.


Maintains portfolio RAID governance through review and tracking of risks, issues, actions, dependencies, decisions, and remediation activities across programs.


Partners with Program Managers and project teams to improve reporting quality, project controls, project plan integrity, milestone management, and governance compliance.


Develops reporting standards, process improvements, training materials, and operational guidance to improve portfolio effectiveness and consistency across teams.


Provides onboarding, mentoring, and training to project managers, PMOs, and delivery teams on Clarity PPM, governance processes, and reporting requirements.


Supports project and program lifecycle activities including ideation, project setup, budgeting support, governance readiness, gating preparation, and portfolio controls.

 **Knowledge \& Skills**

* Knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management practices.
* Strong understanding of enterprise governance frameworks, , portfolio governance, stage gating and audit control environments.
* Proficiency with Clarity PPM and project financial management processes.
* Experience managing executive reporting, governance forums, and stakeholder communications.
* Financial management skills including forecasting, budget tracking, variance analysis, and reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage risks, issues, dependencies, actions, and decision governance across large initiatives.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence outcomes and coordinate work across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong process improvement and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
 **Experience**

* For internal applications \- 24 months as Consultant
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.
* Significant experience supporting project, program, PMO, governance, or portfolio management functions.
* Experience supporting complex regulatory, operational, technology, or business transformation initiatives.
* Experience with portfolio reporting, governance, audit management, financial controls, forecasting, and executive\-level communications.
* Experience working in large, matrixed financial services organizations preferred.

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

description:

Join us as an “AVP – Macro BM” where Barclays has long been a recognised leader in rates and foreign exchange products, and we combine this strength with our focused commodities derivatives and local emerging markets businesses. Our teams, based in financial hubs across the globe, can assist clients with anticipating the impact of macro market moves and events on their portfolios. For example, the impact of central bank interest rate decisions on currency markets, or the relationship between the price of oil and the performance of emerging market currencies.


To be a successful “AVP – Macro BM” role We strive to give clients the critical short\-term and thematic insights they need to effectively manage their portfolios, and partner with them to structure, buy and sell products to meet their hedging and investment goals. Our trading desks specialise in understanding flows across interest rates and FX in G10 and emerging market currencies, including: government bonds, agency and supra\-sovereign bonds, commercial paper, interest rate derivatives (including structured products), inflation\-linked products, cross currency derivatives, spot foreign exchange, foreign exchange forwards and options.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success role candidate would be supporting the Global Macro Business Management team as part of Macro Business Analytics team, Mumbai. Macro Business Analytics team in Mumbai is responsible for producing business critical MIS reports, Business Strategy presentations, Business Performance reviews, Revenue Forecasting Models, Budgeting Models and performing ad\-hoc customized analysis. The candidate would predominantly support the team based out of London \& New York and thus the role will require the candidate to primarily work during EMEA hours.

* Partner closely with Business Managers, Front Office, Finance, Risk, Technology, and other stakeholders to provide actionable insights and support strategic initiatives.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis, management requests, and thematic reviews to support business strategy, resource allocation, and performance optimization.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting frameworks, data governance, and analytical capabilities across the business.
* Translate complex datasets into concise executive\-level insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Contribute to strategic projects, business transformation initiatives, and process automation efforts aimed at improving efficiency and business outcomes.

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**


* Flexibility to work in EMEA hours and adapt to business requirements.
* Strong understanding of Macro products, financial markets, and the broader Markets business.
* Proven experience in creating, enhancing, and delivering Business Management Information (MI) and reporting.

* Strong programming and automation skills, with hands\-on experience in VBA and Python.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.

This role will be based out of NKP, Mumbai.


**Purpose of the role**


To enable the success of the business and assist senior leaders navigate complex challenges, make informed decisions, and achieve their goals


**Accountabilities**


* Collaboration with business and senior leadership to develop and implement business strategies that align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Liaison between different business units and functions, fostering communication and collaboration.
* Management and coordination of strategic initiatives, projects, and change management efforts to optimize business processes and strengthen the control environment.
