**Job Title: HR Manager (Night Shift)**

**Location:**  
IT Park, Plot No. 8A, 5th Floor, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand – 248013

**Shift Timing:** 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM (Night Shift)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-site  
**Experience Required:** 4\+ Years  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and proactive **HR Manager** to lead end\-to\-end Human Resource operations during the night shift. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in recruitment, employee relations, HR operations, compliance, payroll coordination, and performance management while ensuring a positive and productive work environment. Experience handling US shift operations or staffing environments will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities HR Operations

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle from hiring to exit.
* Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies and SOPs.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Ensure smooth HR operations across departments.

Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for technical and non\-technical positions.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Manage offer rollouts, onboarding, and induction.
* Build talent pipelines through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sourcing channels.

Employee Relations

* Handle employee grievances and conflict resolution.
* Conduct counseling sessions and disciplinary actions when required.
* Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Foster a positive workplace culture.

Performance Management

* Coordinate probation reviews and performance appraisals.
* Support managers in setting KPIs and performance improvement plans (PIPs).
* Track employee performance and development initiatives.

Payroll \& Attendance

* Verify attendance, leave records, and payroll inputs.
* Coordinate with the payroll team for accurate salary processing.
* Resolve employee queries related to payroll and benefits.

Compliance

* Ensure compliance with Indian Labour Laws and statutory regulations.
* Maintain documentation related to PT, leave, and employee records.
* Support HR audits and maintain compliance reports.

HR Reporting

* Prepare HR MIS reports and recruitment dashboards.
* Track hiring metrics, attrition, attendance, and employee engagement reports.
* Present HR insights to management.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.
* Minimum **4\+ years** of experience in HR Generalist/HR Operations.
* Experience managing recruitment, employee relations, payroll coordination, and compliance.
* Strong knowledge of Indian Labour Laws and HR best practices.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, HRMS, and ATS platforms.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
* Comfortable working **6:00 PM – 3:00 AM** (Night Shift).

Preferred Skills

* Experience in or Night Shift environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* High level of professionalism and confidentiality.

What We Offer

* Competitive Salary
* Performance\-Based Incentives
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Professional \& Collaborative Work Environment
* Employee Engagement Activities
* Learning \& Development Programs

title: Site HR
description:
**We are a global technology company developing innovative solutions for mining, tunnelling, and construction, improving project safety, environmental impact, and productivity. We offer premium equipment, all\-round aftermarket services and high\-quality chemicals and rock support as our core products to our customers. We operate globally in over 30 countries with more than 1,800 experts. At Normet, we commit to a culture founded in our Values \- Caring, Committed \& Courageous. We foster your talent, with us you shine.**
**Job Title:** 
 Site HR
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Site HR is responsible for managing and executing HR and Administrative activities at the site level, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations, workforce discipline, and employee welfare. The role acts as a key connect between management, employees, and contract manpower — handling all HR \& Admin related matters end\-to\-end (A to Z) at the site, while implementing group HR policies, processes, and practices in line with organizational goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Analysis \& Decision Support** 
 – Prepares, analyzes, and interprets HR data and information to support management decision\-making, and contributes to the development and implementation of HR policies, processes, programs, and practices.
   

  

**Manpower Management** 
 – Handles overall manpower planning, deployment, and coordination at site, including recruitment, onboarding, attendance, and workforce availability, ensuring adequate staffing to meet operational requirements at all times.
   

  

**Critical HR Issues \& Discipline** 
 – Manages critical manpower concerns including disciplinary matters, grievances, conflicts, and misconduct cases; ensures fair and timely resolution in accordance with company policy and applicable labor laws, maintaining a disciplined and compliant work environment.
   

  

**Employee Engagement \& Development** 
 – Drives initiatives for employee engagement, motivation, training, performance evaluation, and rewards/recognition to build a committed and productive workforce.
   

  

**Administration** 
 – Oversees site administration functions including facility management, contractor labor administration, statutory compliance, documentation, and liaison with local administration/government bodies as required.
   

  

**End\-to\-End Site HR Ownership** 
 – Independently manages the complete spectrum of HR \& Admin activities at the site (A to Z) — from manpower planning and welfare to compliance, discipline, and administration — ensuring uninterrupted HR support to site operations.
   

  

**Advisory Support to Managers** 
 – Acts as a trusted advisor to site managers, providing guidance and recommendations on people\-related matters to support effective decision\-making.
   

  

**Team \& Workforce Connect** 
 – Maintains strong, regular connect with manpower, contract workforce, and internal teams to understand ground\-level concerns, ensure smooth communication, and keep HR processes and site operations streamlined.
   

  

**Project \& Program Management** 
 – Contributes to or independently manages assigned HR development projects, programs, and site\-level initiatives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 – Liaises with external stakeholders (contractors, vendors, local authorities, consultants) to ensure the organization consistently receives agreed standards of service.
   

  

**Experience \-Minimum 10 Years**
 Education \- Graduation, MBA HR Preferred
   

  

 Job Location \- HZL SK Mines
   

  

*Come and share your courage to shine with us!*
 Visit our career website for more information.

title: Senior Executive- HR
description:
**About Protsahan**
 Protsahan India Foundation works with 96,000\+ girls annually across Delhi’s slum communities, building pathways out of poverty through education, mental health support, and livelihoods training. As the organisation scales into a pan\-India field\-building model in 2026, the Executive Director’s office requires dedicated, high\-calibre support to manage a wide and demanding portfolio of administrative, regulatory, and coordination responsibilities.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role owns the full employee lifecycle: getting the right people in the door, keeping every statutory filing and HR record audit\-ready, and building the culture and performance systems that let a fast\-scaling, mission\-driven team do its best work. You take ownership of end\-to\-end recruitment and create a talent pipeline.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding**
* Open roles are filled with quality hires on time, and every new joinee is productive and settled within their first month.
* Own end\-to\-end recruitment across levels: draft job descriptions, post on job portals , organization website and NGO\-specific platforms and build referral and campus pipelines for entry level and field roles
* Screen resumes, conduct first\-round HR interviews, and coordinate panel/technical rounds with hiring managers; maintain a live applicant tracker so no candidate falls through the cracks
* Coordinate to deliver structured onboarding and induction programs, including for field\-based and program staff and maintain a live hiring tracker and coordinate with department heads on hiring plans


**HR Operations, Records and Statutory Compliance**
* Every employee file, statutory filing, and compliance requirement is complete, current, and ready for audit at any given point
* Maintain accurate, organised employee records, letters both physical and digital
* Track and close statutory filings and compliance requirements (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, Shops \& Establishment Act, and other labour law requirements)
* Support internal and donor/statutory audits with documentation
* Own the HRMS data accuracy, attendance, leave records etc.


**Employee Relations \& Engagement**
* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries, concerns, and grievances
* Support in implementation of staff engagement initiatives, recognition programs and internal surveys etc.


**Performance Management Coordination**
* Every employee has clear goals, honest feedback, and a documented performance record not a once\-a\-year formality.
* Support managers on performance documentation and feedback delivery
* Track and support probations and Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) where needed


**Payroll Coordination**
* HR policies are currently and consistently applied, and payroll runs accurately and on time, every time.
* Coordinate with Finance for accurate, timely payroll processing
* Ensure policy application is consistent across all teams


**Candidate Requirements**
**Non\-negotiables**
* Impeccable attention to detail
* Process discipline to follow documented procedures and flag deviations
* Absolute discretion with confidential employee and organisational information
* Ability to close the loop on tasks independently, without repeated follow up


**Essential**
* Graduate degree in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR – Senior Executive: 5 to 7 years of work experience as HR generalist
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, POSH, Shops \& Establishment Act)
* Hands on experience with HRMS/payroll platforms (e.g., Keka, Zoho People) and Google Workspace
* Strong written and verbal communication in English and Hindi
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast paced, high accountability environment and collaborative mindset.


**Preferred**
* Prior experience in a non\-profit, foundation, or mission\-driven organisation
* Experience mentoring or supervising HR team
* Ownership of the end\-to\-end HR recruitment function


**Key Working Relationships**
* Direct reporting – HR escalations
* Finance – Payroll coordination, compliance documentation and audit support.
* Program Team – Field staff onboarding, engagement and HR support for program based hires etc.


**To Apply**
 Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to
 **hr@protsahan.co.in** 
 with the subject line “Application: Senior Executive HR”. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
   

  

 We need people who believe that good HR systems are an act of care too because the team that shows up for the girls every day deserves to be shown up for as well.

title: Business System Analyst
description:
WE ARE ON A MISSION — COME JOIN US

**About Natura X**

Natura X is a fast\-growing D2C wellness and skincare company founded by three IIM Lucknow alumni.

We are on a mission to help **100\+ million Indians** living with chronic skin conditions such as psoriasis, eczema, and dermatitis. Through **doctor\-led Ayurvedic care, online consultations, and result\-driven natural products**, we are building an accessible and scalable approach to skin wellness.

With operations expanding across **Calicut (Corporate), Coimbatore, and Bangalore**, we are at an exciting stage of growth.

**Healing Skin. Restoring Lives.**

Business Systems Analyst – AI \& AutomationBuild the systems that power our growth.

We are looking for a **Business Systems Analyst – AI \& Automation** who will play a critical role in building and improving the systems that support our day\-to\-day operations.

You will take ownership of **automation, workflows, CRM processes, AI\-enabled solutions, and technology integrations** across the customer journey — from **lead generation to consultation to customer experience**.

This is **not a traditional support role**. It is a hands\-on **builder and ownership\-driven role**, where you will work closely with the founders and cross\-functional teams to identify problems, build solutions, implement systems, and continuously improve them.

If you enjoy figuring out how things work, building solutions from scratch, and making businesses more efficient through technology, we'd like to hear from you.

***Key ResponsibilitiesAutomation \& Workflow Management***

* Design, build, and manage business automations using **Zapier, Make.com, n8n, Google Apps Script**, or similar platforms.
* Identify repetitive manual processes and convert them into scalable automated workflows.
* Monitor existing workflows and ensure they operate reliably with minimal disruption.

CRM \& Customer Journey Systems

* Own and continuously improve CRM pipelines and workflows.
* Manage **WhatsApp\-based lead and communication systems** across the customer journey.
* Optimise processes from **Lead → Consultation → Customer Experience**.

AI \& Intelligent Automation

* Build and implement AI\-powered workflows for **content, operations, customer support, and internal processes**.
* Leverage tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI/LLM platforms** to improve productivity and automation.

Technology \& Vendor Management

* Coordinate with technology partners, SaaS providers, and external vendors.
* Evaluate new tools and solutions through demos, trials, and structured comparisons.
* Ask the right technical and business questions, identify limitations, and support pricing/solution negotiations.

Testing \& Implementation

* Conduct structured **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** before new systems go live.
* Gather feedback from users and translate it into actionable improvements.
* Drive successful adoption of new systems across teams.

Troubleshooting \& Continuous Improvement

* Diagnose and resolve workflow, integration, and system issues.
* Continuously monitor system performance and identify opportunities to improve **efficiency, reliability, and cost\-effectiveness**.

Documentation \& Enablement

* Create and maintain **SOPs, process documentation, and training materials**.
* Help non\-technical teams understand and effectively use the systems you build.

Metrics \& Optimisation

* Track relevant system and process metrics.
* Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements based on data and operational feedback.

Required Skills \& Experience

* **2–3 years of experience** in Business Systems, Business Operations, Automation, CRM, or related roles.
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining **production\-level automation workflows**.
* Strong practical knowledge of at least one automation/no\-code platform such as **Zapier, Make.com, n8n, Google Apps Script**, or similar.
* Experience with **APIs, webhooks, CRM workflows, and system integrations**.
* Active and effective use of AI tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar LLM platforms**.
* Ability to write, understand, or troubleshoot basic scripts with the support of AI tools — **Google Apps Script / Python basics** is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and understanding of the business impact of system errors.
* Comfortable working with **SaaS providers, technology vendors, and internal teams**.
* Ability to critically evaluate technology solutions and identify potential limitations or risks.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging mindset.
* Ability to collect structured feedback and convert it into practical system improvements.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical team members.
* Good written and spoken English.
* **Malayalam is preferred** for effective coordination with the Kerala team.

The Mindset We Value

We are looking for someone who:

* Has **built or automated something independently** — whether a professional project, personal tool, bot, workflow, or system.
* Thinks **“How can I fix this?”** before escalating a problem.
* Is genuinely curious about technology and learns new tools quickly.
* Takes ownership from **problem identification → solution → implementation → improvement**.
* Enjoys experimenting, testing, measuring, and improving.
* Understands that even a small system improvement can create significant business impact.

**If you have built something you're proud of, show us.**

Eligibility

**Education:**  
B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc. (CS/IT) or equivalent.

MCA / M.Tech / MBA (Technology/Analytics) will be an advantage.

**Experience:**  
2–3 years in Business Systems, Operations, Automation, CRM, WhatsApp Automation, or related areas.

**Freshers may also be considered** if they can demonstrate strong hands\-on experience through **2–3 meaningful projects or production\-level implementations**.

**Location:**  
Calicut / Kozhikode, Kerala.

Candidates must be willing to **relocate to Calicut before joining**.

**Work Mode:** On\-site only. Remote work is not available for this role.

**Language:** English required; Malayalam preferred.

**Joining:** Immediate joiners preferred.

Compensation \& Benefits

**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
*Based on skills, experience, and interview performance.*

Additional benefits include:

* Employee Referral Bonus
* High ownership and direct exposure to founders
* Opportunity to build systems used across a **multi\-city organisation**
* Clear opportunities for **career growth** and increased responsibility
* Exposure to **D2C wellness, digital healthcare, online consultations, AI, and automation**
* Continuous learning and opportunities to develop expertise in emerging AI and technology tools
* Opportunity to join a rapidly scaling organisation at an exciting stage of growth

Role Details

**careers@naturaxventures.com**

⭐ Stand Out From the Crowd

title: Business Analyst
description:
Surat (On Site)
Full Time

### **Key Responsibilities**



PRD Management (Using BDD): Craft clear, concise Product Requirement Documents. We use Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) to write requirements in the simplest possible words—breaking things down into clear rules \& scenarios (Given/When/Then) so everyone is aligned.

Scope AI \& Internal Tools: Define requirements for our internal apps (e.g., Admin Panel) and AI initiatives — an AI Sales Copilot that automates user onboarding while salespeople monitor the flow; an AI Support Quality Agent that analyzes support calls to assist the Support Lead; and an AI Night\-Shift Support Agent that handles customer queries autonomously after hours.

Requirement Delegation: Hand over and explain requirements seamlessly to the Development Team, ensuring they clearly understand the business logic and edge cases before they start coding.

End\-to\-End Testing: Act as the final gatekeeper. When the development team delivers a feature, you will test it against your BDD scenarios to ensure it s exactly as intended.

Product Evolution: Transition into analyzing, benchmarking, and defining user\-facing product features as internal tooling milestones are achieved.
### **Requirements**



The Experience: 1 to 2 years of experience as a BA, Product Analyst, or QA. OR a sharp fresher who can demonstrate a deep understanding of the BA lifecycle and has at least one solid internship under their belt.

The BDD Mindset: You know how to communicate complex features using simple "rules and scenarios". Experience writing Gherkin/BDD syntax is a massive plus.

Full\-Lifecycle Ownership: You aren't just a writer; you enjoy passing the baton to developers and rolling up your sleeves to test the final product.

AI Enthusiast: You don't need to be a coder, but you must be fascinated by AI tools, ChatGPT/LLMs, and how agents can automate manual .

Analytical Thinker: You look at a messy manual process and immediately start drawing a mental flowchart on how to optimize it.

title: RSK-Credit Risk
description:

City: Mumbai
Skill Category: Risk
Description:
**Nomura Overview:**  

Nomura is an Asia\-headquartered financial services group with an integrated global network spanning over 30 countries. By connecting markets East \& West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates, and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions, and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com  

Nomura Services India, (Powai) supports Nomura’s businesses around the world. Powai’s world class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support have played a key role in facilitating Nomura’s global operations and are an integral part of Nomura’s global expansion plans. The Powai operation is a critical part of the platform to support the growth of Nomura’s global business.  

**Divisional Overview:**  

The Risk Management Division encompasses the firm's comprehensive risk framework responsible for determining and managing the overall risk appetite for the firm. The division is responsible for effectively managing the firm's risk\-return profile, which ensures the efficient deployment of the firm's capital. It is one of the firm's core competencies and is independent of the trading areas and operational area.  

The Risk Department at Nomura is broadly organised according to the main risk classes Market Risk, Credit Risk, New Business and Operational Risk. The Risk Department provides senior management with an independent view of the principal risks taken by individual business units.  

**Business Unit Overview:**  

Credit Risk Management (CRM) is an independent risk oversight function, reporting to the Global Chief Risk Officer (CRO). Its mandate is to manage the risk of loss arising from an obligor or counterparty’s default, insolvency, or administrative proceeding, which results in the obligor’s failure to meet its contractual obligations in accordance with agreed terms.  

The process for managing credit risk at Nomura includes:
* Evaluation of likelihood that a counterparty defaults on its payments and obligations.
* Assignment of internal ratings to all active counterparties.
* Approval of extensions of credit and establishment of credit limits.
* Measurement, monitoring and management of Nomura’s current and potential future credit exposures.
* Setting credit terms in legal documentation, including margin terms; and
* Use of appropriate credit risk mitigants, including netting, collateral, and hedging
  

**CRM Powai**


CRM Powai is an integral part of the CRM function globally, responsible for credit risk analysis of a diverse portfolio of counterparties across sectors and regions. The team is engaged in assigning credit ratings, carrying out sector and peer reviews, recommending and monitoring credit limits, suggesting credit terms for legal agreements, tracking early warning indicators, and various other portfolio and exposure management activities, as well as participating in global projects. The unit comprises of Credit Risk Analysis, Credit Risk Exposure management, Cash DVP, Portfolio and country risk sub teams.  

**Position Specifications:**
As Cash DVP credit analyst, you will be responsible for managing cash portfolio across sectors. In this role you will be responsible for managing all aspects of the portfolio, including assign Ratings, Limits, and exposure monitoring, monitoring early warning indicators for Cash DVP. In addition, you will support the build out of specialized data analytics and portfolio tools and actively participate in the risk monitoring of the portfolio. The position requires you to frequently interact with Clients, Traders, Operations, Legal and other teams in Risk Management, and where necessary escalate credit concerns to senior management.


**Corporate Title**  

Associate  

  

**Functional Title**  

Associate  

  

**Experience**  

5\-8  

  

**Qualification**  

CA Fresher/Master’s degree in finance from top institutes  

  

**Requisition No.**  

  

**Role \& Responsibilities:**
The position is for DVP Client Review Team. This is highly visible global role, which involves working across functions and managing the cash DVP client portfolio across sectors and geographies.  

Responsibilities include ensuring the process is effective, stepping in to resolve conflict, escalating issues promptly, presenting at global committees, automating tasks and project management.  

The DVP team has global coverage across all sectors and regions, and is centralised in Powai. The team works closely with Credit Officers in CRM, as well as other divisions including Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, IT.  

Specifically, the DVP team has following responsibilities:
* Assign credit ratings to obligors actively trading on a Delivery v/s Payment (DVP) basis, using internal quantitative models.
* Reaffirm the ratings on an annual/semi\-annual basis for a portfolio of counterparties from across sectors, including Investment Advisors, Funds, Banks, Insurance Companies, Brokers, and Corporates.
* Monitor the performance of Counterparties, market developments, and closely track developments related to Counterparty, industry, regulations, etc. and take appropriate action as necessary.
* Liaise with Front Office / Credit Officers / Middle Office /Operations to correct Data Quality issues.
* Produce weekly Management Information
* Work on adhoc projects required by Front office/Credit Officers of different regions and other global projects for e.g. the development \& maintenance of scorecards, process enhancements, automation etc.
* Build data processes and implement models in Python/ Alteryx to minimize manual effort and enable analysts to effectively and efficiently manage their portfolios.
* Contribute to the firm’s Risk Change agenda and participate in regulatory and audit assessments.

**Requirements:**

  

  

**Mandatory**

  

* CA Fresher/PGDM/MBA (Finance)/ 5\-8 years of prior experience in Credit Risk Analysis of Financial Institutions like Banks, NBFCs, Insurance companies, Broker Dealers etc.
* Strong analytical skills, including data analysis and technological skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to present at Committees and lead Discussion Forums.
* Delivery focussed with the ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines under compressed timescales.
* Attention to detail, ability to understand the big picture and act accordingly.
* The ability to be a “self\-starter”, working without supervision and managing multiple stakeholder expectations.
  
  

**Desired**

  

* Prior experience in credit risk or techno functional role in Credit technology or change management.
* Good understanding of products and credit risk life cycle.
* CFA/FRM charter holders or its candidates pursuing the courses across various levels
* Strong coding skills in Python, SQL, VBA, Alteryx, Power BI, with hands\-on experience in self\-driving the initiatives using these tools

**About Us: Climate Collective Foundation (CCF)**

 Climate Collective Foundation is a not\-for\-profit organization dedicated to supporting climate tech startups. We work within the climate ecosystem to foster innovation by connecting startups with funding, investors, education, and accelerator programs. Our team of 65 members operates collaboratively to drive impactful, sustainable solutions for climate\-related challenges.
 



  





**Role Summary** 





 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented
 
**Business Analyst** 

 to support the growth of the Mosambi platform by assisting with partner outreach, stakeholder engagement, business coordination, and documentation. The role involves working closely with the leadership team to identify prospective partners, coordinate meetings, prepare business materials, manage CRM records, and ensure timely follow\-up on ongoing discussions.
 




  






 In addition to supporting external partnerships, the role will play a key part in strengthening Mosambi's internal business functions by assisting with strategic documentation, business research, partnership proposals, investor presentations, fundraising materials, product roadmap inputs, and other business planning initiatives. The Business Analyst will work closely with cross\-functional teams to gather information, develop high\-quality documentation, conduct market and ecosystem research, and support leadership in driving strategic business initiatives.
 




  






 The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with senior management across startups, corporates, government organizations, investors, and ecosystem partners. This role provides exposure to business development, strategic planning, ecosystem building, fundraising, and partnership development within the climate technology ecosystem.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Partnership Development \& Stakeholder Engagement:** 

 Identify, engage, and build relationships with startups, investors, corporates, ecosystem organizations, government agencies, service providers, and other strategic partners. Conduct outreach activities, schedule introductory discussions, and support the onboarding of partners across Mosambi platform.
 




  





**Business Strategy Support:** 

 Support the leadership team in developing internal strategic business documents that drive the growth of the Mosambi platform. Assist in preparing vision documents, product roadmaps, fundraising materials, partnership proposals, investor presentations, and business plans by conducting research, gathering inputs from internal teams, organizing information, and ensuring documentation is accurate, well\-structured, and presentation ready.
 




  





**Business Coordination \& Relationship Management:** 

 Act as the primary point of coordination between internal teams and external stakeholders by organizing meetings, preparing agendas, creating required documentation, documenting discussions, and ensuring timely follow\-ups. Maintain strong relationships with partners while ensuring smooth communication throughout the engagement lifecycle.
 




  





**Documentation \& Proposal Management:** 

 Prepare partner\-facing materials like presentations, proposals, partnership documents, meeting notes, reports, and other business documentation required for stakeholder engagement. Ensure that all documents are accurate, professionally presented, and readily available for internal and external discussions. 
 




  





**Project \& CRM Management:** 

 Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, business opportunities, meeting outcomes, and follow\-up activities within the CRM system. Track partnership pipelines, monitor progress, manage project timelines, and ensure action items are completed within agreed timelines.
 




  





**Market Research \& Business Analysis:** 

 Conduct market research to identify potential partners, emerging opportunities, and ecosystem trends. Develop target lists, collect business intelligence, and provide insights that support partnership strategy and platform growth.
 




  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 

 Work closely with leadership, product, operations, research, and engineering teams to understand platform offerings and effectively communicate Mosambi's value proposition. Coordinate internally to ensure partnership commitments are executed successfully.
 




  





**Reporting \& Process Improvement:** 

 Prepare regular reports on outreach activities, partnership progress, onboarding status, and business development metrics. Continuously recommend improvements to business development processes, CRM management, and stakeholder engagement workflows.
 




  





**Required Qualification** 



* 2–5 years of experience in Business Development, Partnerships, Business Analysis, Account Management, or Project Coordination.
* Experience interacting with senior management and external stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently and stakeholder engagements.

 The ideal candidate should be comfortable using modern business productivity and project management tools.

 Salesforce CRM; Zoho CRM (or equivalent CRM platforms).
* **Project Management:** 

 Jira; Basecamp.
* **Documentation \& Productivity:** 

 Microsoft Word; Microsoft Excel; Microsoft PowerPoint; Claude; Google Docs; Google Sheets; Canva.

title: Computer Science Faculty Intern
description:
**Job Description: Computer Science Faculty Intern**

**Location:** Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh **Work Mode:** On\-site **Job Type:** Full\-time Internship **Duration:** 6 Months **Experience:** 0–2 Years **Stipend:** ₹5,000 – ₹12,000 per month, based on performance **Department:** Academics / Training

**About HI Labs**

HI Labs is building serious, outcome\-focused technology education programs for students who want to become industry\-ready software engineers.

Our programs focus on **strong computer science fundamentals, practical software development, AI\-native engineering practices, real\-world projects, discipline, and internship readiness.**

We believe students should not just learn how to write code. They should understand **how and why software works**, develop strong problem\-solving skills, and learn how to approach problems like engineers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Software Mentor/Faculty Trainee** who is passionate about software development, enjoys helping others learn, and wants to develop strong skills in both **software engineering and technical mentoring**.

As a Software Mentor Trainee, you will work with students and the academic team to help learners understand programming, computer science fundamentals, software development concepts, assignments, and projects.

This is **not a traditional coding trainer role**. You will be expected to understand concepts deeply and gradually learn how to explain them clearly, guide students through problems, review their work, and connect theoretical concepts with practical software development.

This role is particularly suitable for **fresh graduates, recent graduates, developers with 0–2 years of experience, and candidates with strong technical fundamentals who are interested in teaching or mentoring.**

**Key Areas You May Work With**

Depending on your skills and program requirements, you may work on the following areas:

**Programming \& Problem Solving**

* Programming fundamentals
* Logic building
* Problem\-solving techniques
* Code reading and debugging
* Basic algorithmic thinking
* Programming exercises

**Computer Science Fundamentals**

* Data Structures \& Algorithms
* Database Management Systems
* SQL fundamentals
* PostgreSQL basics
* Operating Systems fundamentals
* Computer Networks basics
* Software Engineering principles

**Software Development**

* JavaScript / TypeScript fundamentals
* Backend development basics
* APIs and request\-response concepts
* Node.js / Express.js
* MERN stack fundamentals
* Git and GitHub
* Clean code and project structure
* Real\-world software development workflows

**AI\-Native Development**

* Responsible use of AI tools in software development
* AI\-assisted debugging
* Using AI for development workflows
* Effective prompting for coding tasks
* Understanding when AI can be used and when strong fundamentals are required

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Software Mentor Trainee, you will:

* Assist in conducting technical learning sessions for students.
* Explain programming and computer science concepts using simple examples.
* Conduct doubt\-clearing sessions under the guidance of the academic team.
* Help students with assignments, exercises, and programming problems.
* Review student code and provide constructive feedback.
* Help students identify and fix errors in their code.
* Guide students through small software development projects.
* Assist students in understanding programming concepts and development workflows.
* Prepare basic exercises, assignments, and revision materials.
* Track student progress and identify areas where additional support is required.
* Maintain session notes and basic learning documentation.
* Collaborate with the academic team to improve learning materials.
* Gradually take ownership of selected topics or modules based on your performance and technical ability.
* Encourage students to develop strong fundamentals, problem\-solving ability, discipline, and an engineering mindset.

**Educational QualificationsPreferred Qualifications**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* M.Tech / M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* MCA

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also be considered if they demonstrate **strong programming fundamentals and genuine interest in software development and mentoring.**

**Experience**

**Experience Required: 0–2 Years**

We welcome:

* Freshers and recent graduates
* Candidates with 0–2 years of software development experience
* Candidates with internship experience
* Candidates with teaching, tutoring, or mentoring experience
* Candidates who have helped peers or juniors learn technical concepts
* Candidates with strong academic or personal software projects

**Prior teaching or mentoring experience is not mandatory.**

For this role, we value **technical fundamentals, communication ability, problem\-solving skills, and willingness to learn** more than years of experience.

**Required Skills**

* Strong programming fundamentals
* Basic understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms
* Basic SQL and database knowledge
* Basic understanding of software development
* Good problem\-solving ability
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Patience when working with beginners
* Basic Git / GitHub knowledge
* Willingness to learn new technologies
* Ability to work collaboratively with students and the academic team

**Good to Have**

Knowledge or experience with any of the following will be an advantage:

* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* Node.js
* Express.js
* React
* MongoDB
* PostgreSQL
* Git / GitHub
* Real\-world software projects
* Technical tutoring or mentoring
* Code review
* AI development tools
* Experience working on development projects or internships

**You do not need to know everything listed above.** Strong fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

You may be a strong fit for this role if you:

* Enjoy explaining technical concepts to others.
* Can explain **why** something works, not just how to implement it.
* Have strong programming fundamentals.
* Can break complex concepts into simple steps.
* Enjoy solving programming and technical problems.
* Are patient when working with beginners.
* Are interested in both software development and mentoring.
* Are comfortable learning from feedback.
* Are willing to continuously improve your technical and communication skills.
* Understand that strong fundamentals are important even when using AI tools.
* Are comfortable working in a disciplined, outcome\-focused environment.
* Are willing to work **full\-time from our Lucknow office**.

**This Role May Not Be Suitable If You**

* Are interested only in coding and do not enjoy helping others learn.
* Cannot explain your technical reasoning.
* Depend entirely on AI tools without understanding the underlying concepts.
* Are unwilling to work on\-site.
* Are uncomfortable communicating with students.
* Are unwilling to receive feedback or improve.
* Are looking only for a passive internship experience.
* Are not interested in developing your communication and mentoring skills.

**What You Will Gain**

During the internship, you will get exposure to:

* Technical mentoring and teaching
* Computer science fundamentals
* Real\-world software development workflows
* Student project guidance
* Code review and debugging
* Assignment and exercise design
* AI\-assisted software development
* Communication and presentation skills
* Working with an academic/technical team
* Developing an engineering\-oriented approach to problem solving

Based on performance, trainees may be given **greater responsibility and ownership of specific topics or modules** during the internship.

**Performance \& Stipend**

The stipend for this internship is:

**₹7,000 – ₹12,000 per month**

The exact stipend will depend on the candidate's **technical ability, communication, mentoring performance, consistency, and overall contribution** during the internship.

Pay: ₹7,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Would you be available to attend an in\-person interview at our Gomti Nagar, Lucknow office?

description:
Fresher
 **Software Engineer (AI)**
-----------------------------------


  
Job Description: We are looking for a curious and driven AI Research Developer to join our expanding team. In this role, you will explore prototype and benchmark emerging AI techniques while working with our engineering teams to turn promising research into deployable software. This position suits candidates who enjoy reading papers, reproducing results, and translating them into working code for real products across cloud and edge environments. Key Responsibilities: Track recent developments in generative AI, agentic systems, and model optimization, and assess their relevance to ongoing and upcoming projects. Reproduce results from research papers and open\-source repositories and build proof\-of\-concept prototypes. Design and run experiments: dataset preparation, training/fine\-tuning runs, ablation studies, and evaluation against defined metrics. Benchmark models for accuracy, latency, memory footprint, and throughput on target hardware. Work with product and engineering teams to hand over validated approaches, including documentation, reference implementations, and integration support. Write clear technical reports, internal documentation, and presentations for both technical and non\-technical audiences. May have to interact with customers to understand problem statements and propose feasible AI approaches. Participate in code reviews, experiment reviews, and team knowledge\-sharing sessions.
  

Skills and Qualifications Must Have: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electronics, Mathematics, or a relevant field. Strong programming skills in Python. Solid grounding in machine learning and deep learning fundamentals: activation functions (ReLU, GELU, SiLU, Softmax), loss functions, optimizers, regularization, and evaluation metrics. Good understanding of Transformer internals (Attention, MLP, LayerNorm, RoPE) and of CNN, RNN, LSTM, and Vision Transformer architectures. Hands\-on experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem. Understanding of the LLM inference pipeline, tokenization, sampling strategies, and KV caching. Familiarity with fine\-tuning techniques (LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, instruction tuning) and experiment tracking. Good knowledge of graph and vector databases and RAG implementation. Strong data structures, algorithms, problem\-solving, and analytical skills. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Ability to read research papers critically and communicate findings clearly. Good to Have: Exposure to quantization, pruning, and distillation techniques for model compression. Experience with inference runtimes such as llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, or TensorRT. Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, MCP\-based tooling) and multi\-step reasoning systems. Exposure to GPU/NPU programming concepts (CUDA, OpenCL) and profiling tools. Exposure to FastAPI / Django / SQLAlchemy for serving prototypes. Publications, preprints, open\-source contributions, or competition results in a relevant area. Working knowledge of C/C\+\+.

description:
Job Requisition ID JR2025205
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 Join NVIDIA's GPU Performance Infrastructure team and be part of a brand\-new journey in validating and shipping next\-generation GPU architectures. At NVIDIA, we empower our engineers to innovate and drive powerful performance through innovative infrastructure and workflows. This role is uniquely positioned to influence the entire lifecycle of GPU performance verification, from early\-stage modelling to post\-silicon validation. With our bold standards and extraordinary team, you'll have the chance to define a significant impact on the future of computing!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design and maintain automated chip performance verification pipelines spanning workload trace generation, multi\-target test execution, results post\-processing, and correlation with architectural performance targets.
* Develop performance monitoring and measurement infrastructure that provides consistent observability across simulation, emulation, and silicon environments.
* Build scalable data pipelines and full\-stack dashboards to ingest, visualize, and compare performance metrics across builds and environments.
* Coordinate with GPU architects to craft infrastructure for performance verification of upcoming architectures.
* Work closely with HW teams to automate and accelerate verification workflows, enabling faster GPU build iteration.
* Empower GPU architects by providing insights to understand current performance and model industry\-leading performance for future builds.
* Improve the daily workflows of the world's top chip architects, contributing to the creation of the next greatest generation of GPUs!


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in C\+\+, with Python for tooling and automation.
* Strong CS fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, OOP, and system design.
* Full\-stack experience with backend (Java/Python), REST APIs, and modern frontend (React/Ember) for data\-intensive applications is a plus.
* Proficiency in databases (SQL, MongoDB) for metrics storage and querying is a plus.

title: Junior/Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**About The Role**
**REMOTE IN INDIA**
 We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest\-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin\-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency. The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self\-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event\-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin\-packing, right\-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.
   

  

 A product mindset \- you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.
 **You build it, you own it.** 
 You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring\-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
* Build the self\-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
* Automate self\-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
* Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.
* Partner with the inference/ML platform team: understand the cluster shapes they need — topology, interconnect, scheduling constraints — and encode them as first\-class abstractions in the platform.
* Engineer it like software: strong typing, automated tests, code review, versioning, and CI/CD for infrastructure code — this is a product, not a collection of Ansible playbooks.


**Requirements**
 Core requirements (all levels):
   

  

* Strong software engineering background in Go, Python, Rust, or similar — you write and test real software for a living.
* Experience with durable workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal, Cadence, or equivalent to run long\-lived, manifest\-driven workflows that survive failures and resume mid\-execution.
* Experience building software control planes or orchestration systems that model state and reconcile it over time (e.g., Kubernetes controllers/operators, custom reconciliation loops, workflow engines).
* Experience with event\-driven systems — designing and building software around message queues, event streams, or pub/sub (e.g., Kafka, NATS, SQS) rather than polling or cron\-driven scripts.
* A product mindset. You’ve built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.


**Nice To Have**
* Exposure to bare\-metal provisioning (PXE/iPXE, Redfish/IPMI, BMC) and/or networking fundamentals (VLANs, BGP, fabric design), or GPU/accelerator infrastructure.
* Experience with GPU cluster software stacks (NCCL, CUDA, InfiniBand/RoCE).
* Prior work at a hyperscaler, GPU cloud, or datacenter\-scale infrastructure organization.
* Systems programming in Rust or Go.


**About Together AI**
 Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month.

 Bolster turns the security paradigm upside down and removes threats and digital risks before an attack occurs. Our protection extends beyond the enterprise to customers and partners. Our approach is the antithesis of today’s cyber defense strategy, which is to wait for an attack than try and prevent it. Or worse, assume you have been breached and hope you can detect it. We leverage the power of AI to apply deep learning, computer vision, and natural language processing to identify criminal intent on millions of web pages daily. We are looking for A\-list talent who will have a meaningful impact, solve new challenges, and take ownership of the future of Bolster. If this is you, apply and join our team!

description:

Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. **Position Summary**
 Shift analyst owning end\-to\-end L1 triage across the security detection surface — cloud audit logs, Kubernetes/OpenShift, identity provider, WAF, container network\-flow telemetry, infrastructure and PKI events — and L1 for PulseAI Managed Services: 24×7 monitoring of the PulseAI platform, OpenShift cluster and customer GPU infrastructure, acknowledgement within tier SLA, first\-level diagnostics, and vendor case creation for confirmed hardware faults.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Triage and investigate SIEM detections; correlate across log sources and enrich with threat intelligence.
* Execute approved containment steps (block requests, token disablement) under the L2/L3 authority matrix.
* Maintain alert\-quality feedback: false\-positive tagging and tuning suggestions into the detection backlog.
* Monitor PulseAI platform health — control plane, authentication/authorisation, tenancy and quota enforcement, admin interface/API, observability services — and OpenShift cluster health (nodes, operators, pods, storage) from the observability stack; acknowledge Severity 1–4 incidents within the customer's tier clocks (Sev 1 in 15–30 minutes).
* Perform first\-level diagnostics on PulseAI, OpenShift and GPU\-node alerts: review platform, control\-plane and workload logs and Grafana panels, distinguish platform faults from hardware, network, storage or customer\-workload issues, and classify severity per the SLA definitions.
* Detect and confirm hardware faults on GPU servers, control\-plane/infrastructure nodes, supported switches and storage; open the vendor case (OEM, neocloud provider or storage vendor) within the tier window (60/30 minutes), record the case reference, and track status until closure.
* Provide Severity 1/2 status updates at the SLA cadence; keep ITSM tickets audit\-grade so SLA reports and availability calculations can be produced from them.
* Author and refresh triage runbooks; coach trainee analysts on shift; coordinate with the NOC shift on cross\-domain events.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* BE/BTech (CS/IT/E\&TC) or equivalent.
* 2–4 years in a SOC/MSSP or 24×7 managed\-operations environment with hands\-on triage ownership.
* Working experience on at least one enterprise SIEM platform; fast ramp to the engagement's AI\-driven SIEM/SOAR stack expected.
* MITRE ATT\&CK\-aligned investigation method; log fluency across firewall, identity, and cloud audit sources.
* Monitor and first\-triage Kubernetes/GKE security telemetry — kube\-audit events and Cilium/Hubble flow alerts — distinguishing routine cluster activity from suspicious behaviour per runbooks.
* Working Kubernetes/OpenShift operations basics — kubectl/oc for read\-only investigation (pod and node status, events, logs, describe), namespaces, operators — and comfort reading Grafana dashboards and platform logs.
* Understanding of GPU\-server health basics (node inventory, GPU type/count detection, utilisation, memory, thermal) and of what constitutes a hardware fault versus a platform fault.
* Disciplined ITSM/ticketing practice and written communication; ability to run a vendor support case end to end.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SIEM query\-language skills (SQL\-style / vendor query languages).
* Read\-only kubectl fluency for alert validation; KCNA or CKA.
* Red Hat OpenShift exposure (DO180\-level or equivalent); GPU\-node monitoring exposure (DCGM\-class exporters, NVIDIA GPU Operator).
* Exposure to switch telemetry (SNMP, syslog, streaming telemetry) and storage health monitoring.
* Intermediate security certification (e.g., CySA\+, CEH or equivalent); cloud audit logging / cloud security fundamentals.

description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Penetration Testing Analyst based in India.**
 This is a remote cybersecurity role within a global Red Team environment focused on identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities before real\-world attackers can do so.
   

  

 You will assess client environments across application or network security, using both established and internally developed offensive security tools.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on penetration testing with client engagement, test\-readiness coordination, and professional security reporting.
   

  

 You’ll investigate emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and exploitation techniques to continuously strengthen your technical capabilities.
   

  

 You will also communicate critical findings directly to clients and help them understand evidence, reproduction steps, and remediation recommendations.
   

  

 The position offers a balance of independent technical work and close collaboration with experienced security and project teams.
   

  

 It is particularly suited to a security professional who combines offensive testing expertise with strong communication, organization, and analytical judgment.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Coordinate testing readiness activities, documentation, schedules, dependencies, and information across business, client, and project teams.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for testing readiness, communicate engagement status, and troubleshoot client\-side readiness issues.
* Use project management tools to monitor tasks, ownership, timelines, milestones, and overall engagement progress.
* Escalate project or technical issues to management when appropriate and proactively take ownership of new challenges and opportunities to add value.
* Conduct penetration testing focused on either application security—including web applications, mobile applications, and APIs—or network security, including external and internal penetration tests and vulnerability assessments.
* Perform manual exploitation testing using tools such as Nmap, Metasploit, Burp Suite, Kali Linux, and other commercial or internally developed security tools.
* Research emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and exploits to support advanced testing activities.
* Document vulnerabilities, exploitation evidence, reproduction steps, technical findings, and remediation recommendations in professional security assessment reports.
* Lead client\-facing calls throughout engagements, including readiness and troubleshooting sessions, project kickoffs, high\- and critical\-finding notifications, and close\-out reviews.
* Work independently while contributing effectively to a broader security team and taking on additional responsibilities as required.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of professional experience in information security, including at least 3 years of hands\-on penetration testing experience.

* Strong understanding of offensive security concepts, application attack vectors, security testing methodologies, and common vulnerabilities such as the OWASP Top 10\.
* Experience with network security concepts, TCP/IP, network appliances, firewalls, WAFs, IDS/IPS, proxies, routers, and load balancers is highly valuable.

We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement*** Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:
* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:*** Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.

**Office 365 Management:**

**IT Hardware and Software Deployment:**
* Ability to deploy and configure new IT hardware and software.

**IT Security:**
* Understanding of IT security implementations, including endpoint protection and server domain controls.

**System Updates and Maintenance:**

title: Enterprise Solutions & Deal Enablement Associate
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


TartanHQ builds **HyperSync** (a unified API layer connecting HRMS, ERP, and CRM systems) and **HyperVerify** (a unified verification platform for KYC, KYB, income, employment, and contact\-point checks, used by banks, NBFCs, insurers, and lenders).  

We're hiring three **Enterprise Solutions \& Deal Enablement Associates** to sit directly with the solutioning lead, founders and CBO, and become the connective tissue between our enterprise clients and every internal team that has to say "yes" before a deal goes live \- Product, Engineering, InfoSec, Legal, and Finance.  

This is not a pure sales role and not a pure support role. You will:* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.
* Own the internal chase: security questionnaires, MSAs/DPAs, commercial paperwork, technical scoping so deals don't stall waiting on an internal team
* Stay the client's single point of contact through the entire journey, from first solutioning conversation through contracting to go\-live, so they never feel dropped between teams
* Bring an end\-to\-end ownership mindset: if something is blocking a deal or a client, it's your job to notice, chase, and resolve it, not to wait for someone to ask


You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
------------------------------

* **Deal Cycle Turnaround:** Reduce time from first solutioning call to signed contract through proactive internal coordination
* **InfoSec/Vendor Questionnaire Turnaround:** Coordinated response within 3\-7 business days of receipt
* **Contract\-to\-Go\-Live Time:** \< 30 days for standard integrations, tracked jointly with Product/Engineering
* **Client Response Time:** \< 4 hours during business hours for any active deal or account query
* **Internal SLA Adherence:** 90%\+ of InfoSec/Legal/Finance/Product touchpoints closed within agreed internal timelines
* **Active Relationships Managed:** Ability to concurrently manage 8–12 live deals/accounts without dropped threads
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Positive feedback from both external clients and internal teams (Product, InfoSec, Legal, Finance) on responsiveness and clarity

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Deal Support \& Solutioning (35%)**

* Support the leaders through discovery calls, solution walkthroughs, and RFP/RFI responses for enterprise prospects
* Translate client requirements (HRMS/ERP/CRM integration needs, or KYC/KYB/income/employment verification needs) into a clear internal brief for Product/Engineering
* Prepare first\-cut proposals, solution decks, sample payloads, and commercial summaries to keep deal momentum going
* Track every open opportunity in a shared pipeline/tracker and flag stalled deals before they go cold

### **2\. Cross\-Functional Coordination – InfoSec, Legal, Finance, Product (30%)**

* Own the InfoSec review process for prospects (security questionnaires, ISO 27001/ISO 27701/AICPA/DPDP compliance documentation, VAPT reports) in coordination with the infosec teams, chase, don't wait
* Coordinate MSA, DPA, SOW, and NDA drafting and redlines between the client and TartanHQ's legal counsel, keeping a clear track
* Work with Finance on commercial proposals, pricing confirmations, PO tracking, and invoicing setup for new accounts
* Liaise with Product/Engineering to confirm technical feasibility, connector availability, and realistic go\-live timelines before commitments are made to clients

### **3\. Client Relationship \& Communication (25%)**

* Act as the client's primary point of contact through the deal cycle and into early production, so the relationship survives handoffs between internal teams
* Run a regular communication cadence (calls, status emails, WhatsApp where appropriate) with enterprise stakeholders including BFSI, NBFC, travel, insurance and pension\-sector clients
* Represent client context accurately back to the leaders and internal teams, no information getting lost in translation
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, additional endpoints) during ongoing conversations and flag them to the leaders

### **4\. Documentation, Reporting \& Process (10%)**

* Maintain a single source of truth for every deal's status: commercial, legal, security, and technical via CRM
* Provide the leaders with a clear weekly view of what's moving, what's stuck, and what needs their direct involvement

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------

* 1–3 years in a client\-facing, coordination\-heavy, or B2B support role (sales support, business operations, account management, pre\-sales, or similar) \- strong freshers with excellent communication will be considered
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Hindi fluency a plus for BFSI/enterprise stakeholder conversations)
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, comfortable chasing multiple internal teams without being told to
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable running trackers/spreadsheets across many parallel deals
* Professional, composed, and articulate when dealing with senior enterprise stakeholders
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Basic working understanding of APIs/integrations sufficient to coordinate (not required to write code)
* Proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel; comfort learning CRM/tracker tools quickly

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech, BFSI, or API\-first companies (internships count)
* Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes: security reviews, legal redlines, vendor onboarding
* Exposure to the lending, insurance, travel, or pension ecosystem
* Familiarity with HRIS, accounting / expense tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Greythr, Zoho, Tally, SAP, etc.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Notion, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* **Client\-first mindset:** Genuinely cares whether the client had a good experience, not just whether the task got closed
* **Ownership mentality:** Drives things to completion with minimal supervision; treats "not my job" as not an option
* **Professional \& sincere:** Represents TartanHQ credibly in front of senior stakeholders at large enterprises
* **Coordination discipline:** Can hold 8\-10 moving threads at once without dropping any of them
* **Composure under pressure:** Enterprise deal cycles involve last\-minute asks and shifting timelines, stays steady through it
* **Growth mindset:** This function is being built from scratch; you'll help shape the playbook, not just follow one
