title: HR & Operations Manager - MedInsight India
description:
**Company Overview**
 Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence.  Our company's purpose is to empower easy, data\-driven decision\-making on important healthcare questions. Through our products, education, and services, MedInsight is making an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing waste. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.
   

  

 MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman, a global, employee\-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 MedInsight company division is hiring an HR \& Ops Manager to serve as the local People Ops Manager for our India Office. This is a dual role spanning Human Resources and Operations. The HR \& Ops Manager will be the on\-the\-ground, go\-to resource for India employees and leaders in MedInsight India, owning core HR operations while serving as the administrative backbone and managing local administrative operations responsibilities that keep the team running in the India office. Reporting to the US\-based Sr. HR Ops Manager, the position will serve as a key link between MedInsight and our Milliman Global Corporate Services (GCS) team, India HR Shared Services, and Finance Shared Services partners.
   

  

 This role requires a polished professional with the ability to apply their expertise to manage day\-to\-day operations and lead complex initiatives that span People Operations and align with company strategic goals. Initially structured as an individual contributor role, the position offers the opportunity to evolve into supervisory responsibility for junior People Operations staff in India. As the role evolves, it may include mentoring and developing team members while fostering an inclusive, high\-performing work environment.
   

  

**Work Arrangement**
 This role requires flexibility to work across India and United States time zones, including regular evening calls and meetings to support the manager and leadership team based in the US Pacific time zone.
   

  

 Regular on\-site presence is an essential part of the role. The role is based in Gurgaon, with an expectation of working from the MedInsight Gurgaon office a minimum of two to three days per week. The role requires a high level of visibility and accessibility to employees and leaders, along with hands\-on ownership of office coordination and related activities.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Core HR Operations and Compliance**
* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations and day\-to\-day employee relations locally, serving as the primary point of contact for HR\-related queries and supporting employees with timely, accurate information.
* Maintain and update employee records in HRIS, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality, and develop processes that sustain high data accuracy across ZingHR, UKG, and MedInsight internal tracking tools.
* Oversee personnel file completeness and audit readiness, ensuring records are accurate, up to date, properly maintained, and readily accessible for audits and compliance reviews.
* Coordinate finance, administration, and leave management processes with GCS HR, India HR Shared Services, and Finance Shared Services teams to ensure seamless HR operations and compliance with company policies.
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws, Milliman and MedInsight policies, and HR legal, risk, and compliance programs in all India HR operations.
* Coordinate leave management and attendance processes with India HR Shared Services, and assist in developing and communicating HR policies, SOPs, and procedures for clarity and consistency.


**Local Partnership and Employee Relations**
* Act as the local go\-to resource for MedInsight India employees and leaders across all teams. Serve as the first point of contact for questions about policy, benefits, leave, payroll, and HR systems, guide employees to the right owner across GCS, India HR Shared Services, and Finance when a request sits outside MedInsight HR, and provide a confidential, accessible sounding board for employees raising concerns.
* Coach managers on policy, employee performance, and employee relations practices, and provide guidance to senior staff on complex HR and employee relations issues, routing complex employee relations, performance, or compliance matters to the Senior Manager, Human Resource Operations and GCS HR.


**Administration and Office Support**
* Manage end\-to\-end logistics for large\-scale events, all\-team meetings, and visitor or leadership travel to the India office, ensuring smooth execution and a positive participant experience.
* Own local administrative coordination, such as vendor and facilities liaison, asset tracking, and travel and expense support in partnership with Finance.  Serve as the point person for GCS, India HR Shared Services, and Finance for local administrative requests, routing them to the right owner.


**Talent, Onboarding, and Offboarding Partnership**
* Partner with leadership and the MedInsight talent acquisition team to support hiring, onboarding, and offboarding processes, including workforce planning inputs and tracker hygiene.
* Lead non\-role\-based MedInsight induction and orientation for India new hires, connecting them to the India HR handbook, benefits, career paths, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with India HR Shared Services and GCS on employment contracts, background checks, system provisioning, and full and final settlements so that joiners and leavers experience a clean, consistent process.


**Performance, Compensation, And Reporting Cycles**
* Manage the India performance management cycle in UKG end\-to\-end, including goal entry, mid\-year and year\-end review launches, and completion tracking against published deadlines.
* Support the annual appraisal, bonus, and salary increment processes in coordination with the Senior Manager, Human
* Resource Operations, India HR Shared Services, Finance, and GCS.
* Develop competency in analyzing HR data for insights and performance improvement; prepare and analyze HR reports and dashboards that support data\-driven decision\-making by MedInsight HR and the COO.


**Engagement, Communications, and Learning**
* Support the implementation of HR initiatives and employee engagement activities that promote an inclusive, high\-performance culture, and act as a key contributor to onboarding, integration, and employee development.

* Conduct initial candidate screening and maintain accurate candidate records.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates to minimize drop\-offs.
* Negotiate offers and assist with the onboarding process.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring updates.

**Recruitment Performance**

* Meet agreed **monthly and weekly hiring targets**.
* Track sourcing, screening, interview, selection, and joining ratios.

* Improve candidate quality and reduce time\-to\-hire.
* Provide regular recruitment reports and pipeline updates to management.

**Requirements**

* **2\+ years of recruitment experience**, preferably with exposure to US hiring.
* Experience hiring for **US voice processes, BPO/customer service, inside sales, SaaS sales, or US\-facing roles**.
* Strong sourcing and candidate\-screening skills.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication.
* Strong understanding of recruitment platforms and sourcing techniques.
* Ability to independently manage multiple positions simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up and candidate relationship management skills.
* Comfortable working with recruitment targets and deadlines.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and recruitment tracking tools.
* Ability to work independently in a **100% remote environment**.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be strongly preferred:

* US recruitment
* US BPO / Voice Process hiring
* US Customer Support hiring
* SaaS recruitment
* SaaS Sales / Inside Sales recruitment
* B2B Sales recruitment
* Recruitment for US night\-shift positions
* LinkedIn Recruiter / Naukri / Indeed sourcing
* High\-volume recruitment
* Agency or staffing recruitment

**Work Schedule**

* **Permanent Work from Home**
* Flexible working hours
* Must be available for a **daily overlap with US PST morning hours**
* Candidates should have a reliable internet connection and a suitable work\-from\-home setup.
* Occasional flexibility may be required based on interview schedules and business requirements.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **results\-driven, proactive, and comfortable working independently**.

The right candidate should not simply post jobs and wait for applications. They should be able to **actively source candidates, build talent pipelines, screen candidates effectively, follow up consistently, and drive candidates through the recruitment process until joining**.

Experience recruiting for both **US voice processes and SaaS sales roles** will be a major advantage.

**Key Success Metrics**

The recruiter's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number and quality of candidates sourced
* Screening\-to\-interview ratio
* Interview\-to\-selection ratio
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio
* Time\-to\-fill
* Monthly successful hires
* Candidate quality and retention
* Effectiveness of different sourcing channels
* Ability to consistently maintain a healthy candidate pipeline

title: Asst. Business Analyst , Now LM
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is one of India's fastest\-growing quick commerce platforms, and our Last Mile (LM) network is the engine that powers every delivery. We are looking for a curious, detail\-oriented Assistant Business Analyst to join the Amazon Now LM team, to build the data insight and reporting backbone that will drive cost and performance decisions across our 1P and 3P last mile channels.
   

  

 In this role, you will own data aggregation, reporting, and insight generation across key LM metrics — including cost per delivery (CPD), rate cards, payout structures, and Delivery Partner performance indicators such as orders delivered, service hours, and distance traveled. You will work at the intersection of data and operations, turning raw numbers into clear, actionable insights that shape how we manage our delivery partner network and control costs.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who is intellectually curious about quick commerce and data science, has a strong instinct to simplify complex data problems, and thrives on delivering results through data\-driven insights.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 LM Cost Reporting: Own end\-to\-end leadership reporting on cost per delivery (CPD) across 1P and 3P last mile channels — tracking actuals vs. targets, identifying cost drivers, and flagging anomalies for review. Prepare and publish regular performance reports for LM operations, finance, and 3P partner management teams. Translate complex data into clear narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Rate Card \& Payout Tracking: Maintain and update store\-level rate card and payout data across the network. Ensure accuracy of payout computations and flag discrepancies between contracted rates and actuals.
   

  

 DP Performance Metrics: Build and maintain dashboards tracking delivery partner (DP) level performance — including orders delivered, service hours logged, distance travelled, and productivity indices — across both 1P and 3P channels.
   

  

 Data Aggregation \& Pipeline Management: Aggregate data from multiple internal and external sources using SQL, S3\-based data pipelines, and Excel (including Macros) to create clean, reliable datasets that power weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting. Pull and process data feeds from 3P partner sources ingested via S3 instances and other data pipelines.
   

  

 JSON Data Management: Leverage JSON to parse, manage, and transform complex nested data structures — particularly for 3P partner data feeds, API outputs, and pipeline payloads — ensuring data is accurately flattened and integrated into reporting workflows.
   

  

 Insight Generation: Go beyond reporting — identify trends, surface anomalies, and generate insights that help the LM pricing and capacity teams make faster, better decisions on DP supply, cost interventions, and partner performance.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day starts with a check on overnight data pipelines — validating that CPD and DP performance dashboards have refreshed correctly, including 3P data feeds ingested via S3\. You spend the morning writing SQL queries to pull the latest payout data, parsing JSON outputs from a 3P partner pipeline, and cross\-checking actuals against rate cards. By midday, you're refining an Excel Macro to automate a weekly cost summary. The afternoon brings a sync with the LM ops team — you come prepared with clean visuals and a clear point of view. You close the day updating dashboards and queuing up the next reporting pack.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Amazon Now Last Mile team is responsible for building and operating one of India's fastest\-growing quick commerce delivery networks. We obsess over speed, reliability, and cost — and we do it at scale, across hundreds of dark stores and millions of deliveries every month.
   

  

 Our LM Pricing team sits at the core of this engine. We define how delivery partners are compensated, how capacity is planned and flexed, and how the network responds to demand volatility. We are a small, high\-ownership team that values intellectual curiosity, operational rigor, and a bias for simplification. If you love turning messy data into clean insights — and want your work to directly shape how millions of customers receive their orders — this is the team for you.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1\+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

 The Data Engineer I work as part of an agile team supporting the organization's Research and Managed Services. This is a hands\-on, hybrid, technical, and operational role. The team members will actively write and maintain code to build data tools, automations, and pipelines, while also performing day\-to\-day operational tasks that keep Research and Managed Services running reliably. The role includes identifying and evaluating internal and external data sources to feed AI\-enabled and traditional research workflows. The team member will assess source relevance, quality, coverage, accessibility, reliability, compliance considerations, and applicability to defined business and technical use cases. The role drives best\-in\-class standards and continuous improvement and requires an adaptable professional who is willing and able to learn and adopt new technologies as they are introduced to the organization
 




  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

**Coding \& Development** 
  

  
* Write, review, test, and maintain code, including SQL and Python, to build data tools, automations, and ingestion and transformation workflows that support Research and Managed Services
  
* Automate manual processes and develop data tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, quality, and throughput
  
* Develop and promote coding standards and contribute to code reviews within the agile team
  
* Build and maintain web\-scraping solutions, API integrations, and reusable data\-processing components
  
* Support scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data
  


  


**Source Evaluation \& AI Enablement** 



  

  
* Identify prospective sources that can feed AI solutions and Research and Managed Services workflows
  
* Define and apply source\-evaluation criteria covering relevance, authority, freshness, completeness, coverage, consistency, accessibility, legal or licensing constraints, privacy, security, and technical compatibility
  
* Perform source profiling, sample validation, proof\-of\-concept testing, and comparative assessments before recommending onboarding
  
* Document source decisions, metadata, lineage, ownership, limitations, refresh expectations, and approved use cases
  
* Implement and support AI\-enabled workflows using LangChain or equivalent orchestration frameworks, large language models, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, and prompt\-engineering approaches where applicable
  
* Monitor source and AI\-workflow performance and recommend remediation, replacement, or additional sources when quality or coverage falls below requirements
  


  

  


**Operational Tasks** 



  

  
* Perform day\-to\-day operational activities supporting Research and Managed Services, including monitoring, exception handling, data maintenance, and issue resolution
  
* Perform database administration activities, including performance tuning and implementation of best practices
  
* Implement new data\-maintenance processes and provide end\-to\-end process ownership
  
* Ensure data integrity by validating, reconciling, and regularly cleaning data
  
* Investigate and resolve production incidents, pipeline failures, data\-quality issues, and operational exceptions
  
* Follow applicable data governance, security, and operational standards
  


  


**Collaboration \& Continuous Learning** 



  

  
* Evaluate and implement new technology solutions, and proactively learn and adopt new tools, platforms, and methodologies introduced by the organization
  
* Communicate with stakeholders and conduct knowledge\-exchange sessions for technical and non\-technical audiences
  
* Develop and maintain data documentation, including data dictionaries, source assessments, data\-flow diagrams, data mappings, runbooks, and data lineage
  
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across Data \& Analytics, Technology, Research Services, Managed Services, Product, and Data Governance
  
* Additional duties as assigned.
  


  

  


  




**Key Skills:** 
  
* Strong SQL and Python skills, with demonstrated ability to write and maintain code as a core part of daily work
  
* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, and other web\-data collection techniques
  
* Experience developing and supporting data\-ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT workflows
  
* Ability to collect and interpret data from multiple sources, including web scraping and GCS/S3, and formats including delimited files, XML, JSON, and PDF
  
* Working knowledge of data systems and databases used to maintain data pipelines
  
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other dashboard tools
  
* Experience managing stakeholders and project plans
  
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  
* Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new technologies as they are introduced
  
* BigQuery experience and knowledge of AWS and/or GCP
  
* Hands\-on experience implementing AI solutions using LangChain or an equivalent orchestration framework
  
* Exposure large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, or graph databases
  
* Knowledge of Data Operations methodologies, data management approaches, ServiceNow, and/or Jira
  
* Experience with NoSQL technologies, SQL Server administration, R programming, web technologies, and data mapping from multiple sources.

title: Senior Associate-RMS Digital RM-Data Analytics
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 Our global Risk Management (RM) function helps EY identify, monitor, and manage risks across our professional practice. The Digital RM team builds the systems, data foundations, and technology capabilities that enable better decision making and stronger risk insights.
   

  

 You will join the RM Data Integration team, a global group responsible for integrating risk\-related data, maintaining semantic structures, and supporting the data backbone for analytics, reporting, compliance, and process optimization.
   

  

 As demand for integrated, high quality RM data continues to grow, we are expanding the team to increase capacity and accelerate our data modernization journey.
   

  

**Role: \- Senior Associate – Data Integration**
**The opportunity**
 We have already established a core data warehouse with foundational semantic models which serves as the nucleus of our data integration landscape. As we continue to expand this platform and evolve toward a hybrid cloud architecture, we are growing the team to strengthen integration capabilities, improve data quality, and enhance the usability of RM data.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate \- Data Integration, you will work closely with experienced team members to expand and improve our RM data landscape.
   

  

 Beyond technical implementation, this role is designed for individuals who want to understand how data represents business concepts and decisions. You will gradually build the ability to connect systems, interpret risk management processes, and contribute to shaping structured data based on real business needs.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of data, systems, and business context — and is ideal for someone who is curious, asks questions, and is motivated to learn how data supports risk management in a global professional environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support the enhancement and extension of the RM data warehouse and existing semantic models
* Integrate data from multiple internal systems to support reporting, analytics, and process automation
* Assist in building and maintaining data relationships, mappings, and documentation
* Contribute to data quality checks, validation logic, and standardization efforts
* Collaborate with global RM teams to understand requirements and support translation into structured data
* Support the development of hybrid cloud integration patterns and workflows
* Help maintain metadata, documentation, and definitions to ensure clarity and consistency
* Provide support to stakeholders by explaining data structures and assisting with data\-related questions
* Actively seek to understand the business meaning behind the data, not only its technical structure


**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**
* You have contributed to integrating additional data sources into the RM data warehouse
* You support improvements in data quality and consistency across selected RM processes
* You have worked on semantic models and understand how they support reporting and analytics
* You contribute to documentation, mappings, and definitions used by the team
* You collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* You show growing confidence in understanding how data reflects business processes and decisions


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
* Curiosity to understand how data reflects real business processes and decisions
* Willingness to learn beyond purely technical topics and engage with risk management concepts
* Ability to ask the right questions when requirements are unclear
* Clear and collaborative communication with global stakeholders
* Structured approach to problem\-solving and eagerness to grow into more ownership over time
* Interest in working across both technical and business domains


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* University degree in Mathematics, Informatics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field
* Initial experience (or strong academic exposure) in working with data (integration, modelling, or analysis), combined with an interest in understanding how data supports business processes
* Basic understanding of SQL and willingness to further develop technical skills
* Strong willingness to learn and grow in a data\-driven role


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Exposure to Python, APIs, or ETL/ELT concepts
* Interest in cloud technologies (Azure, AWS)
* Basic understanding of metadata or semantic modeling concepts
* Interest in risk, compliance, or governance topics


**What Working At EY Offers**
* A role within a growing, globally connected data integration team
* Opportunity to build both technical and business understanding in a risk management context
* Supportive leadership, training, and structured development opportunities
* Exposure to modern data architecture concepts, including hybrid cloud and Data Fabric
* Flexibility in working style and a strong focus on work–life balance


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Purpose**
 Design and deliver data transformation pipelines, semantic models, and BI solutions that enable reliable, self\-service analytics across the organization. The role bridges data engineering and business intelligence, owning the analytical data layer from source transformation through to governed, business\-ready reporting assets.
   

  

 Key Result Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and maintain modular, well\-tested ELT pipelines using tools such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* Build and maintain the semantic/analytical data layer in Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric, including fact and dimension tables, conformed metrics, and reusable dbt models.
* Develop production\-grade Power BI reports and dashboards, including well\-structured data models, DAX measures, and row\-level security configurations.
* Define and implement data quality rules, testing frameworks, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and consistency of analytics outputs.


 Key Result Responsibilities\-Continued
   

  

* Collaborate with data analysts, business stakeholders, and data engineers to translate reporting requirements into robust, governed data assets.
* Apply and enforce dimensional modelling principles (star schema, slowly changing dimensions) to support efficient BI consumption.
* Work within Azure and Snowflake environments to manage datasets, optimize query performance, and control data access.
* Maintain clear documentation for all pipelines, semantic models, metric definitions, and report logic.
* Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to improving team standards for analytics engineering.


**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
* Fluent in English Language.
* ITIL Certification is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong SQL skills and solid working knowledge of Python for data transformation tasks.
* Working knowledge of dbt for transformation layer development, including tests, documentation, and lineage.
* Hands\-on experience with Power BI: data modelling, DAX, report design, and workspace governance.
* Demonstrable experience delivering Power BI solutions in a professional setting.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Factory for pipeline orchestration and data movement.
* Solid understanding of dimensional modelling (star/snowflake schema, SCD types).
* Understanding of BI governance principles: semantic model management, certified datasets, and access control in Power BI.


 Work Experience
   

  

* With 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development.
* Experience with Snowflake or Azure Synapse Analytics for data warehousing and query optimization.
* Experience with Git\-based version control and collaborative development workflows.

title: Data & Analytics Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly curious, and analytical
 **Associate Analyst** 
 to join our growing analytics team. In this role, you will leverage technical capabilities such as SQL and Python to extract, manipulate, and analyze datasets to solve real\-world problems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an early\-career professional (0–2 years of experience) who combines strong logical thinking and data interpretation skills with an eagerness to dive into the
 **Pharmaceutical \& Life Sciences domain** 
 . You will work closely with stakeholders to translate complex data into compelling visual stories, while actively leveraging Generative AI tools to optimize workflows and drive data innovation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Data Analysis \& Problem Solving
   

  

* Extract, clean, and analyze structured and unstructured data using SQL and Python
* Apply logical thinking and structured analytical frameworks to break down complex business questions into actionable insights
* Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy and integrity across reporting outputs


 AI Integration \& Innovation
   

  

* Understand and apply Generative AI tools and techniques (e.g., prompt engineering, LLM\-driven analysis, automated documentation) to streamline analytical workflows and enhance productivity


 Data Visualization \& Storyboarding
   

  

* Translate raw analytical outputs into intuitive dashboard wireframes, visual reports, and data\-driven narratives
* Design clear, impactful presentations/storyboards that communicate key insights and strategic recommendations to non\-technical business partners


 Domain Learning \& Collaboration
   

  

* Rapidly build subject\-matter expertise in the Pharmaceutical domain (e.g., healthcare datasets, commercial analytics, clinical metrics)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, domain specialists, and senior leadership to support key project deliverables
* Communicate findings effectively through clear oral presentations and concise written documentation


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience: 0–2 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative role
* Technical Proficiency:Strong foundational skills in SQL \& Python.Working knowledge or practical understanding of GenAI capabilities
* Analytical Mindset: Excellent quantitative data interpretation skills with a structured, logical approach to problem\-solving
* Data Storytelling: Proven ability or aptitude for data visualization and storyboarding
* Domain Eagerness: Strong enthusiasm and willingness to learn the intricacies of the global pharmaceutical and healthcare market
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences
* Education: Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Pharma, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Specialist Data Engineering**
**The Opportunity**
 Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology\-driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
   

  

 Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
   

  

 This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 with
 **2–4 years of hands\-on experience** 
 in building and supporting data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and analytics\-ready datasets. The ideal candidate should have strong fundamentals in
 **Python** 
 ,
 **PySpark** 
 ,
 **SQL** 
 ,
 **AWS** 
 , and
 **Databricks** 
 , with practical exposure to data lakes, lakehouse patterns, data warehousing, data quality, and production support. This role is best suited for a hands\-on engineer who can work from defined requirements, contribute to reliable data solutions, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and grow into larger ownership over time.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Build, enhance, and support batch and streaming data pipelines using defined technical designs and backlog requirements.
* Develop and maintain ETL/ELT transformations using Python, PySpark, and SQL across data lake, lakehouse, and warehouse environments.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, senior engineers, tech leads, and product managers to understand requirements and deliver curated, analytics\-ready datasets.
* Implement data quality checks, validations, reconciliations, and basic anomaly checks to improve trust and usability of data outputs.
* Run, monitor, and troubleshoot pipelines using orchestration and observability tools such as Databricks Workflows, AWS Step Functions, scheduling, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
* Follow engineering practices including unit testing, integration testing, automated data tests, code reviews, and quality gates within CI/CD.
* Support BI and analytics use cases by applying dimensional modeling concepts such as facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
* Write and tune SQL queries for data profiling, transformations, validations, debugging, and performance improvements.
* Use AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EMR, and CloudWatch to support data engineering workloads while following security practices such as IAM, encryption, and least privilege.
* Contribute to cloud resource provisioning and environment configuration using Terraform, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Package, deploy, and support workloads using Docker and related runtime configurations, including ECS/Fargate where applicable.
* Use GitHub for version control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, and contribution to CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop scalable data processing logic on Databricks / Apache Spark using PySpark and lakehouse concepts such as Delta Lake, ACID transactions, and schema evolution.
* Use Jupyter/Databricks notebooks for exploration, debugging, and PoCs; convert validated logic into reusable modules, tests, and deployment\-ready pipelines.
* Participate in Agile delivery ceremonies, provide task\-level estimates, share progress updates, and raise risks or dependencies early.
* Create and maintain technical documentation such as pipeline specifications, data contracts, runbooks, and support notes.


**What Should You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, including building or supporting production data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows.
* Practical experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EMR, and CloudWatch; understanding of IAM, encryption, and cloud security basics.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, and lakehouse concepts such as Delta Lake.
* Strong SQL skills for joins, window functions, data profiling, transformations, validations, and performance tuning.
* Good working knowledge of Python and PySpark, including Spark fundamentals such as partitioning, shuffle, caching, file formats, debugging, and optimization.
* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts including facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
* Exposure to GitHub, CI/CD, code reviews, branching, release practices, and engineering quality standards.
* Working knowledge of Docker and Terraform for deployment, runtime configuration, and cloud environment support.
* Ability to work in Agile teams, communicate clearly, collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders, and take ownership of assigned deliverables.


**Primary Skills**
 Python, PySpark, SQL, AWS, Databricks, GitHub, Data Lake, ETL/ELT and CI/CD
   

  

**Secondary Skills**
 Dimensional modeling, Docker and Terraform
   

  

**Good to Have**
* Exposure to data quality or testing frameworks such as Collibra, Immuta, and basic awareness of data governance practices including catalog, lineage, and access controls.
* Exposure to orchestration tools such as Airflow or modern table formats such as Delta, Iceberg.
* AWS certification such as Developer or Solutions Architect, or equivalent demonstrated cloud experience.


**Who We Are**
 We are known as well\-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS), CI/CD, Databricks Platform, Data ETL, Data Lake, GitHub, PySpark, Python (Programming Language), SQL Databases
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Dimensional Modeling, Docker (Software), Terraform

 Qualcomm India Private Limited

 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm is shaping next‑generation intelligent and connected experiences. We are seeking multiple highly skilled
 **Machine Learning \& Data Science Engineers** 
 who can independently drive end‑to‑end development of scalable data pipelines, ML/NLP models, and production‑grade Python systems.

 **Machine Learning, NLP, Data Engineering, and Python backend development**

**Key Responsibilities**
**Machine Learning \& NLP**
* Develop, fine‑tune, and deploy ML and NLP models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit‑learn.
* Apply advanced NLP methods including Transformers, BERT‑based models, and LLM fine‑tuning.
* Build Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, FAISS, Milvus, etc.
* Work with model registries and cloud ML environments (HuggingFace, AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML).


**Data Engineering \& Infrastructure**
* Design and implement scalable ETL and data ingestion pipelines using SQL, NoSQL, and big‑data frameworks (Spark, Hadoop, PySpark).
* Build efficient data models, schema designs, and storage strategies (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.).
* Ensure data quality, validation, and governance across distributed systems.
* Own documentation and architecture of data flows.


**Python Development**
* Develop scalable backend components and services using Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django).
* Automate workflows, model pipelines, and data processing using Pandas, NumPy, SQLAlchemy.
* Integrate ML solutions into production systems with clean, modular, well‑documented code.


**Collaboration \& Ownership**
* Work independently to design, build, and deliver complete ML/Data solutions.
* Partner with cross‑functional teams including systems, hardware, architects, and test teams.
* Translate business requirements into technical approaches and drive execution.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field.
* 1\-3 years of experience across ML, NLP, and Data Engineering.
* Expert‑level Python programming with hands‑on experience in backend/API development.
* Strong knowledge of ML/NLP algorithms, LLMs, and RAG frameworks.
* Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Experience with big data tools such as Spark or Hadoop.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem‑solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and take end‑to‑end ownership of solutions.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

title: AI Engineer
description:
The Open Access Technology International (OATI) is seeking motivated individuals to join our AI Engineering team supporting power‑system applications. This role provides the opportunity to apply foundational machine‑learning and programming knowledge to real‑world energy‑sector challenges under the guidance of senior engineers and researchers.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Assist in developing machine‑learning and neural‑network models for forecasting, anomaly detection, Text‑to‑SQL tasks, and data‑driven analysis.
* Support the development and deployment of agentic AI components using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
* Assist in implementing retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources and vector databases.
* Support fine‑tuning and evaluation of large language models using supervised techniques such as PEFT/LoRA and prompt‑engineering strategies.
* Assist in implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) communication and long‑term memory mechanisms for AI agents.
* Support model deployment, monitoring, and maintenance using tools such as MLflow and distributed inference frameworks.
* Participate in data preparation, preprocessing, experimentation, and evaluation workflows.
* Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and data scientists to integrate models, validate results, and support product‑development activities.



**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Foundational knowledge of Python and machine‑learning concepts.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and neural‑network fundamentals.
* Ability to learn new tools and frameworks with guidance.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Effective communication and teamwork abilities.



**Preferred (Not Required)** 



* Coursework or academic projects involving machine learning, LLMs, RAG, or data engineering.
* Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with Git or SQL/NoSQL databases.

title: Data Scientist I
description:
Kroll is hiring a Data Scientist to join its Enterprise Data Group. This role is ideal for an early\- to mid\-career practitioner who is eager to develop deep expertise across the ML lifecycle while contributing to high\-impact work in a sophisticated, collaborative data science team.
   

  

 Our program spans fintech product development, digital transformation, process automation with machine learning, business intelligence, data governance, and generative AI. You will be embedded in a team of experienced data scientists and engineers who will invest in your growth — and work alongside professionals from the world's largest financial institutions, law enforcement agencies, and government bodies.
   

  

 At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients' most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build, train, and evaluate machine learning models across traditional ML, NLP, and LLM/GenAI use cases, under the guidance of senior team members
* Contribute to data pipelines and feature engineering workflows in Databricks using PySpark and Delta Lake
* Support model deployment and monitoring on Azure — including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Functions — and help maintain production model health
* Contribute to LLM and generative AI workflows — including prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agentic applications built on frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex — under the guidance of senior team members
* Conduct exploratory data analysis and communicate findings clearly through code, documentation, and team presentations
* Write clean, well\-tested, and reproducible Python code; contribute to shared codebases and track experiments via MLflow
* Partner with senior data scientists and cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into analytical approaches
* Participate actively in code reviews, team rituals, and knowledge\-sharing sessions
* Develop your skills proactively — engage with new tools, research, and techniques relevant to the team's work


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or a related quantitative field
* 1–3 years of practical data science or ML experience (internships, co\-ops, research, and strong project work all count)
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with core ML libraries (scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy)
* Solid understanding of foundational ML concepts: supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, cross\-validation, and feature engineering
* Exposure to at least one deep learning or NLP framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers) and familiarity with LLM concepts such as prompt engineering, embeddings, or retrieval\-augmented generation
* Comfort working with structured and unstructured data, including text and document\-based sources
* Basic understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data preparation and experimentation through evaluation and handoff
* Clear, organised communication skills — able to document work and explain methods to peers and stakeholders
* Curiosity, rigour, and a strong drive to learn in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, or cloud ML platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI)
* Hands\-on experience with LLM/GenAI and agentic workflows — prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or building with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel
* Familiarity with MLflow or other experiment tracking and model versioning tools
* Experience in financial services, risk, compliance, or a regulated industry
* Knowledge of responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, and data privacy

Kroll is hiring a Data Scientist to join its Enterprise Data Group. This role is ideal for an early\- to mid\-career practitioner who is eager to develop deep expertise across the ML lifecycle while contributing to high\-impact work in a sophisticated, collaborative data science team.
   

  

 Our program spans fintech product development, digital transformation, process automation with machine learning, business intelligence, data governance, and generative AI. You will be embedded in a team of experienced data scientists and engineers who will invest in your growth — and work alongside professionals from the world's largest financial institutions, law enforcement agencies, and government bodies.
   

  

 At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients' most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build, train, and evaluate machine learning models across traditional ML, NLP, and LLM/GenAI use cases, under the guidance of senior team members
* Contribute to data pipelines and feature engineering workflows in Databricks using PySpark and Delta Lake
* Support model deployment and monitoring on Azure — including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Functions — and help maintain production model health
* Contribute to LLM and generative AI workflows — including prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agentic applications built on frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex — under the guidance of senior team members
* Conduct exploratory data analysis and communicate findings clearly through code, documentation, and team presentations
* Write clean, well\-tested, and reproducible Python code; contribute to shared codebases and track experiments via MLflow
* Partner with senior data scientists and cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into analytical approaches
* Participate actively in code reviews, team rituals, and knowledge\-sharing sessions
* Develop your skills proactively — engage with new tools, research, and techniques relevant to the team's work


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or a related quantitative field
* 1–3 years of practical data science or ML experience (internships, co\-ops, research, and strong project work all count)
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with core ML libraries (scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy)
* Solid understanding of foundational ML concepts: supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, cross\-validation, and feature engineering
* Exposure to at least one deep learning or NLP framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers) and familiarity with LLM concepts such as prompt engineering, embeddings, or retrieval\-augmented generation
* Comfort working with structured and unstructured data, including text and document\-based sources
* Basic understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data preparation and experimentation through evaluation and handoff
* Clear, organised communication skills — able to document work and explain methods to peers and stakeholders
* Curiosity, rigour, and a strong drive to learn in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, or cloud ML platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI)
* Hands\-on experience with LLM/GenAI and agentic workflows — prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or building with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel
* Familiarity with MLflow or other experiment tracking and model versioning tools
* Experience in financial services, risk, compliance, or a regulated industry
* Knowledge of responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, and data privacy

title: Data Scientist II-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Data Scientist II\-1
   

  

 We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.
   

  

 Mastercard has over 2 billion payment cards issued by 25,000\+ banks across 190\+ countries and territories, amassing over 10 petabytes of data. Millions of transactions are flowing to Mastercard in real\-time providing an ideal environment to apply and leverage AI at scale. The AI team is responsible for building and deploying innovative AI solutions for all divisions within Mastercard securing a competitive advantage. Our objectives include achieving operational efficiency, improving customer experience, and ensuring robust value propositions of our core products (Credit, Debit, Prepaid) and services (recommendation engine, anti\-money laundering, fraud risk management, cybersecurity)
   

  

**Role**
* Gather relevant information to define the business problem
* Creative thinker capable of linking AI methodologies to identified business challenges
* Develop AI/ML applications leveraging the latest industry and academic advancements
* Ability to work cross\-functionally, and across borders drawing on a broader team of colleagues to effectively execute the AI agenda


**All About You**
 :
   

  

* Demonstrated passion for AI competing in sponsored challenges such as Kaggle
* Previous experience with or exposure to:
* Deep Learning algorithm techniques, open source tools and technologies, statistical tools, and programming environments such as Python, R, and SQL
* 
* Big Data platforms such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, GPU Clusters for deep learning
* Classical Machine Learning Algorithms like Logistic Regression, Decision trees, Clustering (K\-means,
* Hierarchical and Self\-organizing Maps), TSNE, PCA, Bayesian models, Time Series ARIMA/ARMA,
* Recommender Systems \- Collaborative Filtering, FPMC, FISM, Fossil
* Deep Learning algorithm techniques like Random Forest, GBM, KNN, SVM, Bayesian, Text Mining techniques, Multilayer Perceptron, Neural Networks – Feedforward, CNN, LSTM’s GRU’s is a plus.
* Optimization techniques – Activity regularization (L1 and L2\), Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta concepts; Cost
* Functions in Neural Nets – Contrastive Loss, Hinge Loss, Binary Cross entropy, Categorical Cross entropy; developed applications in KRR, NLP, Speech and Image processing
* Deep Learning frameworks for Production Systems like Tensorflow, Keras (for RPD and neural net architecture evaluation), PyTorch and Xgboost, Caffe, and Theono is a plus
* Concentration in Computer Science


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Hyderabad, India**
**.**

 Warner Bros. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.
 





 For more information, please visit
 

 www.wbd.com
 

 .
   


  
   


**Meet our team:**





 The Data \& Audience Platform organization is at the forefront of developing and maintaining frameworks, tools, and data products vital to WBD, including flagship streaming product HBO Max and non\-streaming products such as Films Group, Sports, News and overall WBD eco\-system. The mission of the Content Lifecycle Analytics team is to enable WBD to leverage the world’s most valuable content library and achieve market leading content\-driven business success.​ We foster unified analytics and drive data\-driven use cases by leveraging a robust multi\-tenant platform and semantic layer. We are committed to delivering innovative solutions that empower teams across the company to catalyze customer growth, amplify engagement, and execute timely, informed decisions, ensuring our continued success in an ever\-evolving digital landscape

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Leverage AI\-assisted tools to improve productivity and quality.




**What to Bring:**

* 3\-5 years of experience in building data science models and machine learning solutions.
* Strong understanding of statistics, machine learning algorithms, probability, and data science fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience in developing, and optimizing ML models in production environments.
* Strong programming experience with Python, R, or similar programming languages.
* Experience with ML frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, XGBoost, Keras, and Spark ML.
* Strong knowledge of machine learning techniques, including Regression \& Classification Models, Time Series Forecasting, NLP, LLMs.
* Familiarity with the ML lifecycle including feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving abilities, communication skills, and cross\-functional stakeholder collaboration experience.




**Preferred Qualifications:** 




* Experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker for data visualization, dashboarding, and communicating insights to stakeholders.
* Experience working on personalization, customer growth, advertising, content recommendation, or large\-scale consumer platforms.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and distributed data processing frameworks is a plus.
* Knowledge of modern AI/GenAI tools and frameworks.
* Ability to translate research concepts into practical business solutions.




**What We Offer:**

title: Full Stack Data Engineer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our growing Data \& Analytics team.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building data solutions end\-to\-end—from ingesting and transforming raw data through to modelling, visualization, and delivering actionable business insights. You will work closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions to translate business requirements into scalable data products built on the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a business\-oriented mindset and enjoys owning solutions throughout their lifecycle.
 



  





**Note: Role will require supporting EU/US time zones. Flexibility in working hours is to be expected** 




  





**About Role** 



* Responsible to manage End\-to\-End BI Solution Development
* Design, develop, and implement full\-stack BI solutions from data ingestion through to user\-facing reports and apps.
* Take ambiguous business questions and translate them into well\-defined BI products, including data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
* Manage delivery from discovery and prototyping through validation and production support.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across all BI solutions.
* Data Pipelines, Modelling, and ETL
* Develop and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, dataflows Gen2, copy activities).
* Land, organize, and structure data using Fabric Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse patterns.
* Implement layered data architectures (e.g. bronze / silver / gold) to ensure modular, reusable, and testable transformations.
* Partner with Data Engineers to align on ETL standards, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Apply data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to proactively identify issues.
* Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualization
* Design dimensional and star schemas optimized for BI use cases (facts, dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions).
* Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) with clear, consistent business logic using DAX measures and calculated columns.
* Develop high\-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to real business workflows.
* Implement navigation, drill\-through, parameterized views, and security (row\-level and object\-level) as required.
* Optimize models and reports for performance, maintainability, and scalability.
* Data Analysis and Insights
* Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and deliver actionable insights.
* Support advanced analytics use cases where appropriate, including predictive or statistical models in partnership with other specialists.
* Data Governance, Documentation, and Support
* Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.
* Document BI products clearly, including purpose, data sources, refresh cadence, ownership, lineage, and known limitations.
* Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.
* Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Collaboration and Continuous Improvement
* Work closely with business stakeholders to priorities work and agree success measures for BI products.
* Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.
* Participate in peer reviews of SQL, DAX, data models, and report designs.
* Support continuous improvement of BI delivery practices, promoting full\-stack ownership and reduced hand\-offs.



  





**About You** 



* Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including:
* Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2\)
* Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse
* Power BI datasets, reports, and apps
* Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.
* Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).
* Familiarity with Git\-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.
* Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).



  





**Analytical And Professional Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional, collaborative environment.
* Comfortable working in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.



  





**Education/ Qualifications** 



* Bachelor/Master in relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience (typically 3\+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end\-to\-end BI solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working across the full BI stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

**Description**
 Are you interested in shaping the future of live sports broadcasting? Do you want to set high standards on how Amazon customers are watching live sports?
   

  

 If so, you might be the right person for the Content Associate role on the Prime Video Live Events team, which brings new sports leagues and other live broadcast events to Prime Video customers around the world.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The primary responsibility of the role is to perform quality checks on web pages and digital content for Prime Video Sports and execute test case instructions and report discrepancies on new PV Sports features.
   

  

* The associate needs to perform QA checks on Sports detail pages to ensure the best streaming experience for Sports fans.
* The associate has to perform test case execution and report bugs accurately
* The associate needs to continuously adapt and learn new features on the tools and follow the QA SOP to spot/catch errors in the detail pages.

 A day in the life
   

  

 The primary responsibility of this role is to perform various tasks related to content for the Prime Video Sports catalog, under general supervision. This could involve tasks such as checking and/or fixing metadata, image, subtitles, audio and video assets to provide a seamless viewing experience to PV customers. The day to day job requires the individual to make judgment based decisions by following a standard operating procedure. The associate should have working knowledge of MS office to capture data on daily basis.

**Manual Testing**

**Title And Summary**
 Software Engineer I
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Mastercard Transaction Stream team is involved in developing cutting\-edge solutions to deliver the Next Generation of Core Payment Products for Mastercard. These cutting\-edge solutions are built on the Digital Network Architecture, Cloud Native principles and in a Scaled Agile Framework.
   

  

 As the Software Engineer I of Transaction Stream team, you will be responsible for decomposing business requirements and customer experiences into features and functions that drive the platform/product Quality, Validation, and delivery.
   

  

**The Role**
* Work as a integration team member to deliver end\-to\-end product validation for Transaction Switching Solutions
* Play a crucial part in helping drive Quality to help build and ship better products.
* Practice test engineering methodologies, Mastercard standards and help build high quality software.
* Help make Quality as an integral part of the development process.
* Proactively monitor customer insights and production issues to seek quality feedback and improve processes to enhance quality of the product/capability.
* Drive quality automation and self\-service culture as a part of software delivery practices.
* Acts as first\-review for project\-level reviews, walkthroughs and inspections.
* Communicate effectively and coordinate with various global groups in MasterCard to ensure success of the projects, including Business Owners, Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture teams, Other product teams etc.


**All About You**
* Bachelor/Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Experience on test engineering is preferred.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with great attention to details. (Must)
* Good at test strategy analysis systematically and delivery focused. (Must)
* Experience in Unit, Functional and Integration testing. (Must)
* Practical exposure in building and using test automation framework with Java. (Preferred)
* Experience testing across a variety of platforms: Microservices, Event Driven Applications, and Databases (Preferred)
* Experienced in different protocols testing (SFTP/sockets/HTTPs/RPC..etc) and familiar with CI/CD pipeline (Must)
* Working knowledge of payment simulation tools such as t3 or equivalent, cards and payment flows, and ISO payment protocols (8583/20022\) (Must)
* Strong knowledge of cards and payments domain, message flow and formats. (Preferred)
* Understanding of cloud\-based platform architecture and familiar with micro service test (Preferred)
* Passionate about emerging technologies and trends, especially Event Driven Architecture and modern caching/persistence mechanisms
* Experience in working with Digital Native Architecture, Spring Boot framework and Cloud technology (preferably Pivotal Cloud Foundry) (Preferred)
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills involving Business Owners, Architecture teams, Development/Test teams, Vendors etc.
* Understanding, inclination and experience of working in an Agile (SaFe) environment (Preferred)


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Bangalore, India

 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai

 At West, we’re a dedicated team that is connected by a purpose to improve patient lives that has been at the center of our Company for more than a century. Our story began when Herman O. West solved the problem of supplying penicillin in mass quantities to the US Government during World War 2\. Through our work to deliver thousands of life\-saving and life\-enhancing injectable medicines to millions of patients daily, West’s indelible mark on the healthcare industry has just begun. A name started our story. How will yours help write our future?
   

  

 There’s no better place to join an inclusive community of professionals with opportunities for lifelong learning, growth and development. Supported by benefit programs, we empower the physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our team members and their families.
   

  

 We believe in giving back to help those in need in the communities where we live and work. And are equally committed to creating a healthier environment and planet through our sustainability efforts.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The role requires basic knowledge to participate in design, build, test and deploy effective testing solutions. To fulfill this role, the Support and Testing consultant applies appropriate technologies to meet the short\- and long\-term goals of the Testing and Support organization. This level role provides the opportunity for exposure to fundamental of software Automation testing principles and concepts.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* With guidance will work on SAP Manual Testing, Functional and Regression Test Automation.
* Assist in product design to guarantee adherence of test coverage for meeting end user requirements.
* Test all aspects of the product/system like function/component, system, performance, Regression and service.
* Assist Design and development team to identify and capture test cases, ensure version management.
* Setting up of test environments, designing test plans, developing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases.
* Apply, design and develop automated testing strategies and build automated testing frameworks.
* Record test results, report and verify software bug fixes to accept automation criteria.
* Analyze performance test requirements and develop test plans.
* Handle performance testing and present results for validating and analysis to Project Teams.
* Answer technical issues to resolve and follow up.


****Education****
* Bachelor's Degree in related fields like engineering, design, etc. from Electronics, Computer Science or equivalent. required or
* Master's Degree in related fields like engineering, design, etc. from Electronics, Computer Science or equivalent. required


****Work Experience****
**Minimum 1 Year Of Related Work Experience Required**
****Shift****
 12:00 PM \- 9:00 PM Indian Standard Time
   

  

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
 Possesses exposure to or education in the following:
   

  

* An understanding of the software development life cycle as well as the business approach for the product
* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Manage customer expectations regarding estimated response times for issue resolution.
* Resolving the issues through Phone, chat, and email communication channels.
* Meet SLAs like response and resolution times with help of Functional and Technical team.
* Collaborate with Functional and Technical Support team members to properly manage customer inquiries and escalate when appropriate.
* Own customer technical issues from initial report to resolution, communicating with customers regularly regarding issue status.
* Run monitoring reports for usage, performance, and/or availability.
* Document solutions for knowledge\-base and bring new ideas for innovation and automation excellence into the Support team.
* Understanding of Microfocus ALM Software (Microfocus Quality Center) Testing Tools
* Experience making data\-driven decisions using analytics, A/B testing, Campaign reports, and Dashboards, Analytical skills
* Ability to work in a team as well as an individual
* Ability to work in a global and virtual environment and to effectively prioritize and execute tasks
* Able to be aware of all relevant SOPs as per Company policy as they are related to the position covered by this Job Description
* SAP Testing, SAP Test Automation and Validation, Knowledge of Azure DevOps and Jira is plus


****Travel Requirements****
 10%: Up to 26 business days per year
   

  

****Physical Requirements****
 Sedentary\-Exerting up to 10lbs/4kgs of force occasionally, and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.
